jobs.title: Health Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Healthcare Staffing Professionals has an immediate need for a Health Program Coordinator. HPC duties must comply with established Department of Public Health (DPH) policies procedures, state and local laws, ordinances, and regulations for the control of communicable disease. HPC must maintain client confidentiality requirement per the Health Insurance Portability Accountability Act (HIPAA). In addition, staff must adhere to LAC DPH, and Protected Health Information, procedure, policies, and ordinance pertaining to HIV Security and Confidentiality laws and trainings.



The Division of HIV and STD Programs (DHSP) Health Program Coordinator (HPC) plans, coordinates, and implements public health programming by providing direct services in the field, developing and monitoring management and logistical processes, assists Public Health Investigators (PHIs) for the control of communicable diseases with special focus on HIV and STIs. Assignments may include but not limited to linking clients to HIV care and syphilis treatment, conducting specialized CDR interviews with clients, transporting clients to high priority medical appointments, conducting chart reviews, providing Field Delivered Therapy (FDT), collaborating with other Direct Community Services (DCS) programs to implement field based/mobile testing services. The HPC supports data management efforts including data entry, data quality assurance, analyzing HIV and syphilis labs, and collaborating with surveillance units. The HPC will lead planning and logistics for outreach events for special initiatives and DCS programs.



The positions will start immediately upon acceptance and employment clearance and are initially funded through 8/31/27, with the good chance of extension.


**Pay Rate:** $30\.24/hr working 40 hours a week


**Location**: Hybrid 2 days a week in office. Telework/Field works the remaining days.


**Benefits**: Paid Holidays, Paid Sick Time, PTO


**Healthcare**: Employer Fully Funded Healthcare (Anthem Blue Cross), Dental and Vision, Life Insurance from Initial


**Job Duties:**

* Activities include but are not limited to conducting linkage to care, treatment, biomedical prevention, or other essential services for priority clients/contacts; conduct Cluster Detection and Response (CDR) enhanced re\-interviews; support case investigation and documentation; analyze HIV and STI case information to develop and implement timely disease intervention plans; complete treatment verification and chart reviews; counsel and educate clients on risk\-reduction and prevention strategies; provide FDT and other supplies such as self\-test kits, condoms, harm reduction items.
* Develop tracking plans, service reports, and scopes of work to ensure goals are met.
* Coordinate outreach activities to support DCS program efforts. Lead logistical activities to prepare and report event outcomes. Support testing events as the mobile unit driver, on\-site coordinator, working with venue partners.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, within the scope of a Health Program Coordinator at DHSP.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, within the scope of a Health Program Coordinator at DHSP.


**Qualifications:**

* Four years of experience in planning and implementing organized community programs and activities in public or community health, delinquency prevention, community relations, or community welfare. Graduation from an accredited college or university with a degree in public health will be accepted for one year of the required experience.
* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Thorough knowledge of HIV and STI testing, biomedical prevention, and treatment protocols.
* Knowledge of HIV/STI, drug treatment, mental health, housing service programs.
* Ability to complete HIV/STI counseling and testing training and certification.
* Knowledge of and experience with HIV/STI labs, data, data systems, and quality assurance standards.
* Strong outreach skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills (verbal and written).
* Knowledge with Microsoft Word, Access, Excel, Power\-point, and ability to learn internal data systems.
* Able to participate in field\-based services.
* **Preferable**: Bilingual Spanish


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.



TrueBlue, Inc. And its brands welcome and encourage applications from candidates with disabilities. jobs.description:
In order for your application to be considered, please attached a cover letter and CV to your employment application.

**Position Description**


The Schaeffer Institute is seeking a **Research Program Specialist** to provide high\-level administrative leadership for the USC Mann Department of Pharmaceutical \& Health Economics, and to take on new programmatic support for the Institute leadership team and its growing modeling research program. Working with established and up\-and\-coming scholars, the **Research Program Specialist** will develop and spearhead new procedures and processes to support an in\-demand research team and their work with sophisticated data and modeling tools developed at the Institute. The **Research Program Specialist** will assist in program development and ensure that deadlines and milestones are met. The position will report to the Schaeffer Institute Director of Operations (in coordination with respective departmental leadership), who will help oversee the portfolio of work and ensure a collaborative and creative work environment across teams. The right candidate will contribute ideas, identify opportunities, and help shape priorities to ensure leadership and program success.


This position offers a unique opportunity in the substantive work of a policy research center and an important academic department. The right candidate will have administrative expertise, high attention to detail, and enthusiasm for supporting a robust research agenda, faculty activities, and student engagement. The Schaeffer Institute serves a varied group of internal and external constituents—including students, academics, executives, philanthropists, and leading policymakers and staffers—across the political spectrum. Demonstrated experience working with leading faculty and scholars to support research goals is a plus.

**Research Program Leadership**

* Coordinate administrative functions for the modeling research program and other research initiatives as directed by Schaeffer leadership, including acting as a point of contact, responding to requests and inquiries, and managing program content.
* Assist program leadership and key stakeholders with anaylsis, research, and presentations.
* Manage program deadlines; coordinating and tracking grants, projects, and timelines to ensure deliverables and milestones are met.
* Support reporting and proposal development, including budget tracking, grant submissions, and compliance processes.
* Coordinate and contribute to research studies, proposals, and grant\-related research activities.
* Contribute to administrative leadership team meetings and support to Schaeffer academic and policy programming as time allows.

**Department Leadership**

* Oversee Department Chair’s administrative duties by managing calendars, coordinating meetings, preparing course materials, and assisting with day\-to\-day departmental operations for leading faculty.
* Organize departmental events, including conferences, seminars, special events and faculty meetings by managing logistics, vendor communications, facilities, catering, guest accommodations, and event execution.
* Collaborate with the USC Mann communications department to maintain and update the department website, ensuring accurate content, multimedia displays, and compliance with program policies.
* Execute two full\-cycle faculty recruitment searches by arranging candidate travel, accommodations, campus itineraries, interview schedules, and job talks; contributing to the successful hiring of two junior faculty members.
* Lead academic program services and activities including course scheduling, student recruitment initiatives, student summer programs, graduate program’s brown bag series, prospective student visit days, and new student orientation.

* Act as the liaison between graduate students and the GAO, facilitating effective communication and ensuring students receive accurate information and support throughout their time in the program.
* Manage department faculty, students, and Schaeffer Center member travel, travel reimbursements.
* Process journal publication fees, manuscript edits, and purchase research materials while ensuring compliance with university policies and procedures.

Bachelor’s degree

**Minimum Experience:**


2 years of relevant experience

**Compensation**


Commensurate with experience and qualifications. Position is 100% FTE


Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.


The hourly rate range for this position is $40\.95 \- $46\.28\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

**Work Arrangement**


Expected to work onsite 2\-3 days per week at USC University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA

This is a full time, fixed term position through June 30, 2029 (with the possibility of renewal) with a hybrid work arrangement

The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy \& Government Service develops evidence\-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. jobs.title: Account Manager / Permit Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About National Permit Group**

National Permit Group is a full\-service permit and planning firm based in West Hollywood, CA, helping residential and commercial clients get their projects approved and permitted — primarily throughout Southern California, with additional projects in other states. We work with homeowners, developers, contractors, and property owners — and because we have an in\-house design team preparing architectural plans, we're able to offer clients a complete path from design through permit issuance.

Getting a project approved isn't just paperwork — it's a relationship business. Plans sit with city reviewers, questions come back, engineers need to weigh in, clients want to know what's actually happening. We're looking for someone who can own that relationship on all sides: the client who wants answers, and the city officials, plan checkers, and engineers who have them.

**About the Role**

We're hiring an **Account Manager / Permit Coordinator** to serve as the primary point of contact between our clients and everyone involved in getting their project permitted — city planning and building departments, plan checkers, permit techs, structural engineers, and contractors. This is not a data\-entry or paperwork\-routing role. It's a relationship and advocacy role: you're the person who knows the status of every project, knows who to call when something stalls, and knows how to ask the right question to get it moving.

What You'll Do

**Client Relationship Management**

* Serve as the main point of contact for residential homeowners and corporate clients (retail, restaurant, hospitality) throughout their project's permitting process
* Proactively communicate project status to clients with specifics — current stage, what's driving any delay, and the next concrete step — rather than a generic "still pending"
* Send plans to clients for review and approval, and manage their feedback
* Respond to client emails and calls promptly and knowledgeably

**City \& Agency Coordination**

* Communicate directly with city and county building/planning departments, plan checkers, permit techs, and officials
* Push each project forward by asking the right questions of reviewers and officials — identifying who's responsible, what's causing a delay, and when escalation is warranted — rather than passively waiting on a response
* Make submittals and pick up/drop off plans at city building and planning departments as needed
* Upload and download plans and corrections through city and agency portals
* Manage the issuance of permits once approvals are complete

**Project Coordination**

* Track every project's status in Trello, including when corrections come back and when plans are sent to the structural engineer
* Coordinate with our in\-house design team, structural engineers, and outside contractors to keep projects moving
* Flag risks or delays before they become client\-facing problems

**Administrative Support (light)**

* Keep project files and portal access organized
* Occasional coordination of ownership calendar/meetings related to client projects

**What We're Looking For**

*Required*

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a client\-facing coordination role — account management, client services, project coordination, or similar — ideally in construction, architecture, real estate development, or a related field
* Comfort being persistent and assertive with government offices and third parties on a client's behalf
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical/process status in plain language to clients
* Highly organized and able to track multiple projects at different stages simultaneously
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (occasional travel to city offices and project sites)

*Preferred*

* Experience with permit processing, plan checking, or municipal approval processes
* Familiarity with Trello or similar project\-tracking tools
* Background or coursework in architecture, urban planning, or construction management
* Existing relationships with Southern California city planning/building departments

**What Makes You Successful**

* You take ownership of a project rather than waiting to be told what's next
* You're comfortable pushing back and escalating — professionally — when something isn't moving
* You can hold a lot of moving pieces in your head (or your Trello board) without dropping them
* You're as comfortable talking to a homeowner as you are to a plan checker
* You like being the person who actually knows what's going on

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II
jobs.description:
Job Title: Clinical Research Coordinator II


Reports to: Research Regulatory/QC Manager


Location: Sherman Oaks and Travel within Greater Los Angeles, CA

  

Job Summary


The Clinical Research Coordinator II is a critical, high\-autonomy role that makes clinical research accessible to our patient population while providing administrative support to the clinic. Working on behalf of the Principal Investigator (PI), this individual independently manages the full study lifecycle—from feasibility and start\-up, through patient recruitment, eligibility assessment, and follow\-up, to the preparation and gathering of all data and documents for this highly regulated process. This role is best suited to a coordinator who has run trials with significant independence at a smaller or independent site, is comfortable owning multiple functions at once, and can train and mentor less experienced coordinators as our research program grows.

  

Major Duties \& Responsibilities


Research

* Works with PI to meet or exceed study enrollment as per Sponsor’s inclusion/exclusion criteria
* Complete feasibility questionnaires based on site information and all regulatory start up packages
* Recruits and enrolls patents in a friendly and professional manner, screening for eligibility criteria
* Conducts patient visit, collects all required data in appropriate formats, and follows up with all subjects as appropriate
* Reports, tracks and follows up on an all adverse events, protocol waivers, deviations and violations
* Complies with all study protocol, SOP and reporting requirements in a timely manner
* Responsible for completion of all required documentation with keen focus on the integrity of the data submitted by careful source document review, monitoring for missing data and/or inconsistencies.
* Maintains thorough and accurate records per regulatory/compliance standards at all times including but not limited to data for potential inspection; signed informed consents, source documentation, drug dispensing logs, subject logs, and all study related communication
* Creates study specific tools for source documentation when not provided by sponsor
* Collects, completes and enters data into study specific forms and/or electronic data capture system
* Appropriately handles and records all specimens; prepares specimens for shipment; tracks all shipments; tracks all inventory and calibrations.
* Attends relevant meetings (e.g. SIVs, PSSVs, IMVs, COVs, audits); assists Sponsor and FDA with any audits and responds to any monitoring/audit findings
* Actively communicate with stakeholders as appropriate (Sponsor, IRB, vendors) and maintain active communication on status of each study with PI and management as directed
* Trains, mentors, and provides day\-to\-day guidance to less experienced coordinators and clinic staff on research processes, GCP, and site systems; serves as a point of escalation for research\-related questions
* Independently owns day\-to\-day research operations for the site with minimal oversight, exercising sound judgment to prioritize competing study demands

  

Other

* Works in clinic to operate clinic cleanly, safely and efficiently
* Prepares exam and treatment rooms per cleaning protocols; assists with all processes (within scope of certification) to maintain inventory of supplies, medication, and equipment necessary for the operation of the clinic.
* Keys data into EMR/forms to maintain accurate office and patient records
* Organizes tasks to facilitate smooth work/patient flow
* Schedules and registers patients; referrals to specialists as appropriate
* Handles routine administrative tasks (filing, correspondence, mail) as needed to support clinic operations
* Adheres to all company policies and procedures, business conduct and work compliance standards
* Will be required to travel and work at multiple clinics within a reasonable driving distance from home clinic
* Any other task reasonably requested by company to meet its goals

  

Job Related Skills/Competencies

* Effective use of computerized patient care system
* Knowledge of medical terminology
* Knowledge of all safety requirements when handling biohazardous specimens or contaminated instruments
* Strong interpersonal skills to interact with patients, families, ancillary departments, physicians and co\-workers in a courteous and compassionate manner
* Strong, courteous and professional verbal skills to effectively convey sensitive information in a courteous manner in person or on the telephone; effective written communication and computer skills for proper charting
* Ability to work well under pressure and be quick on your feet
* Has a contagious and positive work ethic; models our core values
* An effective team player who contributes valuable ideas and feedback and can be counted on to meet commitments
* Proficient use of EMR and CTMS systems and ability to effectively use our systems within 2 weeks
* Demonstrated ability to train, mentor, and provide constructive feedback to less experienced coordinators
* Ability to independently manage multiple studies and competing priorities with sound judgment and minimal supervision, consistent with experience at a smaller or independent site
* Proficient use of Microsoft (e.g. Office, Excel, Word)

  

Education/Qualifications

* High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree in a health science or related field preferred
* Minimum of 2\-3 years of clinical research coordinator experience at an investigational site required, with solid knowledge of clinical trials terminology, processes, forms and reporting
* Experience at a smaller or independent site network, with broad ownership across regulatory, recruitment, data, and monitoring\-visit functions, strongly preferred
* Prior experience training, onboarding, or mentoring other coordinators preferred
* Certification (e.g. CCRC via ACRP or CCRP via SOCRA) a plus
* Phlebotomy certificate preferred
* Current Medi\-Waste Training for: Blo

In this role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading a team of vehicle operators. This involves a team testing on public roads and private facilities, executing safety protocols, and performing specialized test procedures. You’ll also work with hardware and software engineering teams as needed to help achieve strategic goals.  

* Coordinate project requirements and scheduling, ensuring sufficient coverage.
* Assign test routes and vehicles to vehicle operators based on vehicle availability and test plan.
* Act as the primary point of contact on\-site for the vehicle operator team.
* Implement processes, procedures and work instructions.
* Collaborate with engineering to achieve strategic goals.
* Prepare training materials and assist in onboarding new vehicle operators.
* Motivate vehicle operators to reach objectives and maintain high performance and safety standards.
* Maintain vehicle operator relations, resolve conflicts and foster a positive, productive and professional work environment.
* Ensure test / route schedules are maintained by monitoring driving habits, implementing procedures and/or equipment as required.
* Set key operational performance indicators to measure success and perform data analytics.
* Develop and manage detailed operational reports, dashboards and tools to report results in an accurate and timely manner.
* Ensure essential tools and equipment are well\-organized and easily accessible.
* Perform vehicle inspections to ensure safety, functionality and cleanliness. Perform initial troubleshooting, hardware and software issue investigation and software updating.
* Oversee the transfer of the drive data from the vehicle to the cloud/servers.
* Must be able to work 1st Shift (6:00a \- 2:30p)

  

* Previous supervisory experience, preferably in an professional automotive driving or autonomous vehicle testing experience.
* Flexible and able to perform various tasks as requested.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and capable of good judgment in a fast\-paced, high\-stress environment.
* Attention to detail, excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to describe events quickly and concisely.
* Proficiency using a smartphone, laptop, and Google tools (Docs, Sheets, Maps).
* Must be flexible to work overtime as needed.
* Must be flexible to travel as needed.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
* Minimum age of 21\.
* No driving related suspensions or revocation of Driver License (within a 3\-5 year period).
* No drug or alcohol related driving incidents in the last 3 years.
* No more than 1 serious moving violation in the last 3 years.
* Must have a valid driver's license in the state of residence that you will be driving/operating a vehicle.

Bonus* Experience with Atlassian products.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting and debugging software and hardware programs in vehicles.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Logistics Operations Coordinator to join our supply chain team. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the efficient management of warehouse distribution, transportation planning, and inventory control processes. Your expertise will ensure seamless coordination across multiple departments, optimize logistics workflows, and drive continuous process improvements. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast\-paced environment where proactive problem\-solving and cross\-functional collaboration are key to success.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate warehouse operations including shipping, receiving, stocking, and materials handling to ensure timely order fulfillment and inventory accuracy.
* Manage transportation logistics using transportation management systems (TMS) and ERP platforms to optimize freight routes, costs, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee procurement activities such as sourcing suppliers, negotiating pricing, and managing vendor relationships to secure cost\-effective materials and services.
* Conduct data analysis utilizing tools like SQL, Excel, and Tableau to monitor supply chain performance metrics, identify root causes of issues, and recommend process improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on demand planning, production scheduling, and category management to align inventory levels with forecasted demand.
* Ensure compliance with international trade regulations and trade compliance standards for import/export activities.
* Lead initiatives for process improvement in warehouse management systems (WMS), inventory management systems (IMS), and related software to enhance operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience practicing in a supply chain operations or logistics role with a strong understanding of warehouse management, transportation planning, and materials handling.
* Proficiency in ERP systems such as AS400 or SAP, Warehouse Management System (WMS), Inventory Management Systems (IMS), and transportation management systems (TMS).
* Strong data analysis skills using Excel (including data collection and analysis), SQL, Tableau or similar tools for supply chain analytics.
* Knowledge of international trade regulations, trade compliance standards, and NVOCC (Non\-Vessel Operating Common Carrier) operations.
* Ability to negotiate effectively with vendors and suppliers while managing procurement processes.
* Skilled in freight management, shipping \& receiving procedures, 3PL (third\-party logistics) coordination, and transportation logistics.
* Excellent communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration and customer service excellence.
* Forklift certification or experience operating warehouse equipment is preferred but not mandatory.

Join us as a Logistics Operations Coordinator to be at the forefront of supply chain excellence! Your expertise will help streamline operations, reduce costs, and elevate our service levels—all while working in a vibrant environment that values innovation and teamwork.

Pay: $3,500\.00 \- $5,000\.00 per month

jobs.description:
**ABOUT COLAB**

Colab Marketing Group is a field marketing agency that staffs and runs live brand activations \- tastings, launches, festivals, retail demos \- for spirits, beer, cannabis, wellness and lifestyle brands. We're headquartered in Denver with a growing Los Angeles program and a national footprint.

**THE ROLE**

You'll be our operations person on the ground in LA, working with our Operations Manager to keep California events staffed, confirmed and running. Mornings you'll send day\-of check\-ins and confirm the week ahead. When a brand ambassador drops or a client adds something late, you fill the gap and keep everyone informed. Every other week you'll spend a half\-day with our team at our coworking space in LA, and you'll be at select activations to see how they run.

This is a new seat. It starts part\-time and grows with our event volume, and the person who owns it well moves up with us.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Confirm shifts and run day\-of check\-ins with field teams
* Fill open shifts from our roster, and flag early when one won't fill
* Handle no\-shows and last\-minute changes, and keep the client informed with a solution, not a problem
* Answer team questions during your coverage blocks so nothing sits unanswered
* Be on site at select LA activations, and at our coworking space every other week
* Log what happened so the next person never has to guess

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* You live in the LA area and can be in person on the days we set together
* Self\-directed and fast \- you act when something comes up, not later
* Clear, professional written communication
* Honest about problems and mistakes, including your own
* Steady when plans change
* Available for some evening and weekend blocks; we set them in advance
* Coordination, staffing, hospitality or event experience is a plus. Reliability matters more than resume.

**HOURS AND PAY**

* About 20 hours a week to start, set weekly, heavier during big activation weeks
* $25/hour plus performance incentives
* Hybrid: most of the work is from wherever you are; in\-person days in LA as scheduled
* Training on how our events run before you run one

**HOW TO APPLY**

Reply with a short note, three to five sentences: why this role, what you've done that's closest to it, and one time you fixed something that went sideways at work. Then tell us the neighborhood you live in. A short, specific note beats a long resume.

Pay: From $25\.00 per hour

jobs.title: Customer Success Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Home From College**
---------------------------


Home From College (H\\FC) is redefining how brands connect with the next generation of talent and consumers. With over 500,000 Gen Z students across every major U.S. campus and 1,000\+ brand partners including Uber, Poppi, and Etsy, we're building the leading platform where students turn creativity into opportunity—and where brands authentically show up on campus and online.


Backed by Google Ventures and leading investors, we're in a stage of rapid growth and are looking for a Customer Success Coordinator to help scale the operational engine behind every campaign we run. This role sits on the Customer Success team with close partnership across Marketing, Sales, and Product.

**The Role**
------------


We're seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to keep brand accounts moving — owning the day\-to\-day execution that gets students recruited, work reviewed, and campaigns delivered on time.


This role is the operational core of how H\\FC delivers for brands. You'll review submissions against brand briefs, recruit and follow up with student participants, collect and verify live content links, and build the tasks that turn a brand brief into completed work. It's high\-volume, fast\-turnaround, and standards\-driven: when it's done well, students get paid on time, brands see momentum, and the team stays focused on relationships and growth.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **microGIG Submission Review:** Review student submissions against the brief and approve, request revisions, or reject. Apply consistent quality standards and flag edge cases to CS rather than guessing.
* **Participant Recruiting:** Source and invite students into open microGIGs based on brand fit and requirements. Follow up with students who haven't accepted or started, and backfill drop\-offs to keep GIGs fully staffed.
* **Content Link Collection:** Chase and confirm live links for published content across platforms. Verify links are live, correct, and attached to the right submission, and escalate unresponsive students after standard follow\-up.
* **Task Creation \& Management:** Build and assign participant tasks from brand briefs. Keep task details, deadlines, and deliverables accurate in the platform, and update or close tasks as scope shifts.
* **Account Support \& Risk Flagging:** Keep account records and trackers current. Surface risks early — stalled GIGs, unresponsive participants, brands going quiet. Be proactive about identifying problems and implementing solutions.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 1–3 years of experience in operations, coordination, customer support, or community management — ideally at a marketplace, creator platform, or high\-growth consumer company.
* Extremely reliable and responsive; this role is critical for student and brand deadlines.
* Strong written communication — a lot of this job is clear follow\-up with students and brands.
* Detail\-oriented and genuinely comfortable with repetitive operational work at scale.
* Good judgment on when to make a decision and when to escalate.
* Comfortable in a dashboard, spreadsheets, Slack, and within AI tools.
* Bonus: experience with creator or influencer programs, marketplace operations, or campus and student communities.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive annual base compensation
* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Plan

jobs.description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Ready to take your career global?**


Make your mark with one of the biggest names in payments. At Global Payments, you help businesses grow by transforming how they accept and manage payments. As a B2B Outside Sales Representative on the Genius® team, you bring innovative solutions directly to business owners and create a real, measurable impact on their day\-to\-day operations.


You will join a team powered by energy, curiosity, and shared success. You will learn from experienced people leaders, build meaningful connections, and grow your career in a global business that is always evolving. Every conversation you lead and every relationship you build moves the future of commerce forward.


In this role, you’ll drive new business, shape client success and own outcomes that increase revenue, improve operations, and create long\-term value. You will lead the full sales cycle, influence decision\-making and bring the power of Genius® to life for businesses across your market.

**What you’ll own**

* Drive new business growth by creating opportunities through field outreach, digital engagement and local networking
* Own the full sales cycle, turning conversations into revenue and delivering consistent results in your territory
* Build trusted relationships with business owners, positioning yourself as a go\-to advisor who understands their goals
* Deliver compelling, value\-driven presentations that show how Genius® improves operations, increases loyalty and fuels growth
* Shape your territory strategy using market insights, strengthening your pipeline and accelerating deal momentum
* Expand Global Payments’ impact by introducing innovative solutions that help businesses operate smarter and grow faster
* Strengthen long\-term client value by identifying opportunities to expand solutions and deepen relationships
* Spend up to 75% of your time in the field, creating meaningful, face\-to\-face connections that drive results

**What you bring**

* At least one year of success in B2B or business\-to\-consumer (B2C) outside sales, with a track record of delivering results
* Strong ability to communicate, present and negotiate, both in person and virtually
* Confidence building relationships quickly and earning trust with business owners
* A competitive, self\-driven mindset with the energy to achieve and exceed goals
* Ability to think like a client and connect solutions to real business outcomes
* Valid driver’s license and comfort spending up to 75% of your time in the field
* Residence within two hours of the territory to stay connected and responsive

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* A proven ability to upsell and cross\-sell existing merchants on new features, software add\-ons, and hardware upgrades.
* Experience working with the restaurant or retail industries is a plus.
* Two full years of B2B Outside Sales experience, preferably in fintech, merchant services or Saas.

**Our perks \- what we’ll bring for you**


We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.  

* A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution
* Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business
* Access to learning, development and on\-the\-job experiences that expand your expertise
* A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter
* Time to give back through community and charity initiatives
* A global employee assistance program to support your wellbeing
* Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements.

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.


Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.


Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

**Job Title:** Executive Operations Associate

**Reports to:** President

**FLSA:** Non\-Exempt \- Full\-time

**Location:** Los Angeles, California (Hybrid Role)

**Date:** August 20, 2026

***To apply for this role, please send a 15\-30 second video or cover letter sharing why you think you would be a great fit for this role, along with your resume to admin@collaborationslicensing.com***

About Collaborations

Collaborations is a full\-service licensing agency with offices in Los Angeles and Miami, and services clients across entertainment, music, fashion, food, health \& beauty, home and more. The agency works closely with clients on strategy and execution across licensing, collaborations and partnerships. The agency is well\-known for its cultural driving partnerships, entrepreneurial spirit, and has expertise across brand extensions, brand partnerships, and inbound licensing \& collaborations.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive operator who will help maximize the effectiveness of the President, leadership team, and broader organization. This role is for someone who will make everyone around them more effective.

You'll work closely with executives, the broader team, and clients, so discretion, professionalism, and a proactive mindset are essential.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

* Manage executive calendars, scheduling, travel, expenses, meeting preparation, and day\-to\-day coordination.
* Anticipate needs, track follow\-ups, and ensure priorities and commitments don't fall through the cracks.
* Conduct research and support presentations, documents, and other executive or company initiatives.
* Coordinate internal meetings, including agendas, notes, action items, and follow\-through.
* Own day\-to\-day office operations, including vendors, supplies, equipment, shipping, visitors, and meeting spaces.
* Support team operations, including events, new\-hire logistics, internal communications, and key team moments.
* Coordinate client meetings, kickoffs, onboarding, documents, files, trackers, and project follow\-up.
* Support business development through prospect research, meeting preparation, pipeline tracking, scheduling, and follow\-up.
* Coordinate trade shows, conferences, and company events, including travel, schedules, materials, and logistics.
* Take ownership of special projects across the business
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve organization, communication, and processes across the company.
* Jump in wherever needed to help the President and team operate more effectively.

Non\-Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

* Assist with other jobs and other duties as necessary

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills and Abilities)

* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across executive, team, client, and company needs
* Proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs, exercise good judgment, and act without always being asked
* Strong sense of ownership and follow\-through — you close loops and make sure things get done
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential information
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment where priorities can change quickly
* Low\-ego, team\-first mentality with a willingness to jump in wherever needed
* Comfortable learning and working across technology, including DocuSign, presentation software, shared drives, and other business tools
* Curiosity around AI and emerging tools, with an interest in finding ways to make yourself and the team more effective
* 2\-5 years of experience supporting executives or working in a face\-paced agency, entertainment, consumer brand or similarly demanding environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the Co-Founder and President
jobs.description:
Mavida Health is an online therapy and psychiatry platform focused on supporting women through major transitional moments in life \- from PMOS \& PMDD through Menopause and everything in between. We provide integrated, evidence\-based care through individual, group, and couples therapy as well as medication management, co\-founded and led by reproductive psychiatrist Dr. Sarah Oreck.  

  

Now a WPS Healthcare Company, Mavida Health combines the best of both worlds: the speed, autonomy, and impact of a high\-growth startup with the resources and reach of a legacy healthcare organization. Our team is small, nimble, and mission\-driven, which means ideas move quickly, decisions are made close to the work, and every employee plays a meaningful role in shaping the company's future. As we continue to grow, we're looking for people who are excited to build, innovate, and help redefine women's mental healthcare at scale.  

  

We are looking for an Executive Assistant to partner directly with our Co\-Founder and President, Dr. Sarah Oreck.


Dr. Oreck is a board\-certified reproductive psychiatrist, a company founder, a frequent speaker and media voice, and a mother of three. This is not an entry\-level coordination role. We're looking for someone who has supported a startup founder or C\-suite leader before, who knows how to adapt when priorities shift three times in a week, and who builds the systems that keep an executive ahead of it rather than buried under it.


This is a fully remote role. You'll need to be available during Pacific Time core hours and responsive when something time\-sensitive comes up outside them.


The Executive Assistant will:

* Own the CEO's calendar end\-to\-end\- scheduling, prioritizing, resolving conflicts, and protecting time for deep work and clinical hours
* Manage a high\-volume inbox: triage what comes in, flag what needs her, and draft responses on her behalf
* Prepare briefing materials, agendas, and background research ahead of leadership, partner, payer, and press meetings
* Capture notes and action items, then drive follow\-up to closure across the leadership team
* Book and manage all travel, including itineraries, ground transportation, and contingency plans
* Manage inbound speaking, podcast, panel, and media requests \- vetting, scheduling, prep, and logistics
* Coordinate leadership meetings, offsites, and all\-hands logistics
* Process expenses, manage vendor and subscription accounts, and maintain organized digital filing systems
* Support board and reporting logistics, including materials prep and deadline tracking
* Provide a defined level of personal scheduling and logistics support, coordinating the practical overlap between a founder's professional and personal calendars
* Take on special projects that free up executive bandwidth \- research, drafting, process design, and cleanup work
* Be comfortable wearing multiple hats \- even those that don't fit squarely and traditionally within your job description, because hey, we're a startup!

  

**Requirements**  

* 5\+ years supporting senior executives, including at least 2 years directly supporting a founder or C\-suite leader at an early\- or growth\-stage startup
* Demonstrated success in a fully remote role \- you know how to build trust and stay in sync without an office
* Exceptional attention to detail. You proofread; you double\-check
* Strong written and communication skills. You can draft an email in someone else's voice and have it land correctly
* Sound judgment and comfort with ambiguity. You make decisions, escalate the ones that need input, and operate with autonomy
* Absolute discretion with confidential information \- company, financial, and personal
* Self\-starter with a "no problem is too big or too small" attitude
* Fluency with Google Workspace, Slack, and modern scheduling and project management tools; quick to learn new systems or implement ones that are beneficial for productivity
* Availability during Pacific Time core hours
* Passion for women's healthcare, maternal healthcare, and/or mental healthcare \- and the desire and drive to change the dismal status quo

  

**Benefits**  

* Comprehensive training/onboarding
* Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, plus Health Savings Account (HSA) for relevant plans
* 401(k) through Betterment
* Flexible PTO: Mavida Health offers paid time off to full\-time employees for vacations, holidays, sick days, and personal time, as well as a unique flex time policy that covers shorter breaks
* Personal equipment budget (Apple laptop \+ one auxiliary item)
* Opportunities for ongoing mentorship, in\-person meetings, and professional development

jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** PROGRAM SPECIALIST,EDUCATION

**REPORTING TO:** PROGRAM MANAGER

**DEPARTMENT:** UNITED FOR STUDENT SUCCESS

**POSITION:** FULL\-TIME / NON\-EXEMPT

**Purpose of Position**

The Program Specialist, Education is a dynamic, student\-centered professional dedicated to empowering high school students through Orange County United Way’s Youth Career Connections program—a comprehensive college and career readiness initiative spanning junior and senior years. This role provides individualized coaching and strategic guidance to a cohort of 100 students, helping them build and execute personalized career and success plans.

Equal parts mentor, educator, strategist, and program builder, the Program Specialist, Education plays a pivotal role in shaping students’ career journeys. Responsibilities include one\-on\-one coaching, career and education planning, mock interviews, internship support, and the development of scalable program frameworks.

This is a one\-year grant\-funded position.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities** 

**Student Coaching \& Support**

* Conduct regular one\-on\-one coaching sessions (in\-person or virtual) with each student.
* Develop, monitor, and refine individualized education and career success plans.
* Connect students to relevant resources, workshops, and actionable next steps.
* Guide students through career assessments, academic milestones, and planning timelines.
* Support students in identifying and applying for internships, training programs, post\-secondary education, and employment opportunities.
* Provide feedback on mock interviews and assist in creating professional materials (e.g., resumes, portfolios, headshots).
* Equip students with essential interpersonal and workplace readiness skills.
* Foster a supportive environment that promotes self\-sufficiency and career confidence.
* Serve as a consistent and trusted point of contact throughout the program.
* Assist with planning and execution of career events, industry site visits, workshops, and presentations.

**Program Development \& Strategy**

* Design and document coaching frameworks, operating procedures, and policies.
* Create student\-facing tools and resources (e.g., trackers, checklists, guides).
* Collaborate with program leadership to evaluate and evolve program strategies based on student outcomes and feedback.

**Training \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop and deliver onboarding and training materials for future Career Coaching Advocates.
* Partner with high school staff, internship providers, and external stakeholders to support student placements and progress.
* Facilitate group workshops, presentations, and seminars focused on career readiness.
* Collaborate with high school staff, local businesses, and community partners to identify and secure internship hosts, ensuring successful student placements and ongoing support.
* Support outreach and recruitment efforts to engage students in U4SS programs and support their ongoing participation and success.

**Program Evaluation**

* Adhere to program participation criteria and reporting protocols.
* Track and report student progress, outcomes, and overall program impact.
* Participate in regular check\-ins with leadership to assess program effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.

**Other Duties**

* Participate in organization\-wide activities and initiatives.
* Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

**Job Requirements /Technical Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in education, counseling, social work, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in academic advising, student support services, or coaching/counseling roles.
* Proven ability to build rapport with high school students from diverse backgrounds.
* Strong knowledge of college and career planning, internship programs, and educational systems.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
* Experience developing policies, training materials, or curricula is highly desirable.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish or other languages) preferred but not required.
* Must demonstrate excellence in on\-site engagement, performance tracking, and student satisfaction

**Compensation**

* Commensurate with experience, education, and market, $26\-36/hour. Competitive Benefits.

* **Customer Service** \- Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; responds promptly to customer needs; solicits customer feedback to improve service; responds to requests for service and assistance; meets commitments.
* **Interpersonal Skills** \- Maintains confidentiality; listens to others without interrupting; keeps emotions under control; remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.
* **Oral Communication** \- Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and obtains clarification; responds well to questions; participates in meetings.
* **Written Communication** \- Writes clearly and informatively; edits work for spelling and grammar; able to read and interpret written information.

Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Ready to take your career global?**


Make your mark with one of the biggest names in payments. At Global Payments, you help businesses grow by transforming how they accept and manage payments. As a B2B Outside Sales Representative on the Genius® team, you bring innovative solutions directly to business owners and create a real, measurable impact on their day\-to\-day operations.


You will join a team powered by energy, curiosity, and shared success. You will learn from experienced people leaders, build meaningful connections, and grow your career in a global business that is always evolving. Every conversation you lead and every relationship you build moves the future of commerce forward.


In this role, you’ll drive new business, shape client success and own outcomes that increase revenue, improve operations, and create long\-term value. You will lead the full sales cycle, influence decision\-making and bring the power of Genius® to life for businesses across your market.

**What you’ll own**

* Drive new business growth by creating opportunities through field outreach, digital engagement and local networking
* Own the full sales cycle, turning conversations into revenue and delivering consistent results in your territory
* Build trusted relationships with business owners, positioning yourself as a go\-to advisor who understands their goals
* Deliver compelling, value\-driven presentations that show how Genius® improves operations, increases loyalty and fuels growth
* Shape your territory strategy using market insights, strengthening your pipeline and accelerating deal momentum
* Expand Global Payments’ impact by introducing innovative solutions that help businesses operate smarter and grow faster
* Strengthen long\-term client value by identifying opportunities to expand solutions and deepen relationships
* Spend up to 75% of your time in the field, creating meaningful, face\-to\-face connections that drive results

**What you bring**

* At least one year of success in B2B or business\-to\-consumer (B2C) outside sales, with a track record of delivering results
* Strong ability to communicate, present and negotiate, both in person and virtually
* Confidence building relationships quickly and earning trust with business owners
* A competitive, self\-driven mindset with the energy to achieve and exceed goals
* Ability to think like a client and connect solutions to real business outcomes
* Valid driver’s license and comfort spending up to 75% of your time in the field
* Residence within two hours of the territory to stay connected and responsive

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* A proven ability to upsell and cross\-sell existing merchants on new features, software add\-ons, and hardware upgrades.
* Experience working with the restaurant or retail industries is a plus.
* Two full years of B2B Outside Sales experience, preferably in fintech, merchant services or Saas.

**Our perks \- what we’ll bring for you**


We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.  

* A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution
* Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business
* Access to learning, development and on\-the\-job experiences that expand your expertise
* A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter
* Time to give back through community and charity initiatives
* A global employee assistance program to support your wellbeing
* Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements.

https://jobs.globalpayments.com/en/why\-global\-payments/benefits/

 **What makes a Globalpayer?**


Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.


Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.


Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

**Benefits**


Global Payments offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement programs, charitable gift matching, and more. Learn more at Global Payments Benefits.


Diversity and EEO Statements


Global Payments is an organization that stands against racism, intolerance and injustice in all its forms — one that respects, honors and celebrates the diversity of our team members and the differences among us. Our commitment to fostering a company culture that values and respects Inclusion and Diversity is steadfast. Standing together as one company, we will continue to work to drive positive change for the communities in which we live and work and stamp out injustice.


Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Retail Operations Assistant Manager, Fashion Island
jobs.description:
At Nespresso, we place people and specialty coffee at the heart of what we do. As part of our team, you'll be empowered to inspire, care, act, and innovate to reach your full potential and reimagine what coffee can be. As a certified B Corporation, we're committed to driving our triple bottom line – People, Profit, and Planet – by delivering an exceptional coffee experience that elevates our community, suppliers, farmers, and each other, channeling our growth\-minded spirit to set new standards in global coffee culture. Quality, sustainability, diversity, and inclusion are core to who we are and critical to our vision of driving positive change. Throughout our factories, boutiques, and office locations, Nespresso careers are brimming with best\-in\-class opportunities for your development and growth. Join us!

**Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become. Let’s grow together.**

  

Join Nespresso as an Operations Assistant Manager at our elegant retail boutique at Fashion Island Mall. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of our retail boutique. You will oversee daily store functions, manage inventory, and uphold safety and compliance standards, all aimed at enhancing both employee and customer experiences. This position requires a proactive leader who can effectively guide the back\-of\-house team while also supporting front\-of\-house operations. If you are passionate about delivering exceptional service and improving operational efficiency, we invite you to apply.

 **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* **Competitive Pay**: Enjoy competitive pay along with quarterly bonuses for achieving team sales and service goals.
* **Growth and Development**: At Nespresso, you can build a career that aligns with who you are. Benefit from excellent training programs that empower you to take ownership of your career journey.
* **Caring Culture**: Nespresso is known for a culture that inspires you to be, feel, and do your best. We offer a supportive and collaborative team environment, making working with us feel like a fresh cup of coffee – warm, welcoming, and revitalizing.
* **Purposeful Work**: As a B Corp, we view coffee as a force for good. Enjoy work that makes a positive impact on people and the planet.

 **WHAT WE OFFER:**

  

Nespresso offers retail employees performance\-based incentives and a comprehensive total rewards package, including:

* A free Nespresso machine and coffee product allowance
* 401k with company match
* Educational reimbursement
* Health and mental wellness programs
* DE\&I resource groups
* Commuter benefits
* Pet adoption reimbursement
* Employee recognition program
* Discounts at over 2,000 companies

  

(Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position.)

 **WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:**

* **Operations and Inventory Management**: Partner with the Boutique Manager and Assistant Manager to ensure adherence to Retail Operations Procedures and Best Practices. This includes implementing safety protocols, managing cash operations, and overseeing stock and inventory management. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate inventory levels, processing shipments, and ensuring the proper handling of damaged or defective products.
* **IT Systems Management**: Ensure that all technological systems function correctly by troubleshooting issues and managing IT support tickets. You will oversee the racking system and ensure that all equipment is operational, facilitating smooth back\-of\-house operations.
* **Store Services**: You will maintain, teach and train employees on the coffee roaster, engraver, and the To\-Go and tasting bar.
* **Omni Services Coordination**: Manage the fulfillment of customer orders, including same\-day delivery and online in\-store pickups, ensuring that all services are executed efficiently and to the highest standards.
* **Operational Efficiencies**: Continuously identify areas for improvement within operations to enhance efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction. You will implement Total Quality Management (TQM) principles while adhering to safety protocols.
* **Compliance Oversight**: Ensure full compliance with health, safety, and environmental policies by conducting regular audits, inspections, and maintenance checks. You will lead initiatives to promote a safety\-conscious culture and ensure that all employees are certified in Food Safety and CPR as per local regulations.
* **Team Leadership and Development**: Guide, support, and coach the back\-of\-house team to deliver exceptional customer experience through adherence to operational standards. You will also step in as the Manager on Duty (MOD) for front\-of\-house operations, assisting on the sales floor as needed and driving both employee and customer experiences.
* **General Support**: Assist the leadership team with various projects and tasks as business needs arise, contributing to the overall success of the boutique.

 **WHAT YOU WILL BRING:**

* High School Diploma or GED required
* 3\+ years’ experience in retail or customer service industry related profession
* Experience in operations or back of house preferred
* Proven ability to effectively lead and influence people; leadership experience preferred
* Process and detail oriented with a systematic approach to work
* You will be an analytical problem solver; capable of identifying areas of inefficiency and creating solutions
* Availability to work open and closing shifts, weekends, and holidays
* Able to travel up to 10% for required meetings or training

  

Salary: $64,000\.00 to $73,000\.00 per year

  

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

  

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

  

Nestlé offers performance\-based incentives

jobs.title: Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**Saddleback Lanes** is a well\-established bowling and entertainment center serving the Mission Viejo community. We provide a welcoming environment for casual bowling, leagues, group events, birthday parties, arcade entertainment, dining, and other social activities.

We are seeking a dependable, organized, and customer\-focused **Operations Assistant** to support our day\-to\-day operations. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in an active environment, communicates well with others, and is comfortable handling a variety of operational and customer service responsibilities.

Position Overview

The **Operations Assistant** helps ensure daily activities throughout the facility run smoothly, efficiently, and professionally. This position provides support with guest services, event preparation, operational supplies, facility organization, administrative tasks, and coordination between team members.

The ideal candidate is reliable, detail\-oriented, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy entertainment environment. Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, entertainment, or general operations is helpful but not required. Training will be provided for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities

* Support daily operations throughout the bowling and entertainment center
* Assist guests with general questions, directions, and basic service needs
* Help coordinate bowling activities, reservations, leagues, parties, and group events
* Assist with preparing areas for birthday parties, corporate events, and other scheduled activities
* Communicate with team members to help ensure events and reservations are prepared on time
* Monitor operational areas and report maintenance, equipment, or service issues
* Assist with organizing operational supplies, equipment, and materials
* Help receive, organize, and distribute supplies as needed
* Maintain accurate basic records, checklists, and operational documentation
* Assist with tracking inventory levels of frequently used supplies and materials
* Support opening, closing, and shift transition procedures as assigned
* Help maintain clean, organized, and guest\-ready common areas
* Coordinate with front desk, food service, event, and facility staff as needed
* Respond professionally to routine guest questions and concerns
* Follow established company procedures and workplace safety guidelines
* Assist management with general administrative and operational tasks
* Perform additional duties as needed to support smooth daily operations

Qualifications

* Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, entertainment, administrative support, or operations is preferred but not required
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Friendly and professional communication skills
* Ability to work effectively in a busy, customer\-facing environment
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and changing priorities
* Dependable attendance and punctuality
* Basic computer and data\-entry skills
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
* Comfortable working independently and as part of a team
* Positive, flexible, and service\-oriented attitude
* Willingness to learn different areas of facility operations

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods
* Ability to move throughout different areas of the facility during the shift
* Ability to bend, reach, carry, and perform light physical tasks as needed
* Ability to assist with moving supplies, event materials, and equipment safely

What We Offer

* Training and support for job\-specific responsibilities
* Friendly and team\-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to gain experience in entertainment and hospitality operations
* Variety of customer service and operational responsibilities
* Opportunity to learn multiple areas of the business
* Potential for additional responsibilities and professional growth

Join Our Team

At **Saddleback Lanes**, creating a positive guest experience depends on teamwork, organization, and dependable daily operations. Our Operations Assistant helps keep activities coordinated, supports our team, and contributes to a welcoming environment for every guest.

If you are organized, dependable, customer\-focused, and enjoy working in an active and social environment, we encourage you to apply for our **Operations Assistant** position.

Pay: $20\.30 \- $24\.40 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Clinical Inventory Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
FocusKPI is seeking a **Clinical Project Coordinator** to join one of our clients, a high\-tech SaaS company.  

  

As a Clinical Project Coordinator, your main responsibility will be to support clinical studies by maintaining the efficiency and organization of laboratory operations. You will maintain the laboratory inventory, prepare devices, and handle office administrative tasks for the Clinical Verification and Validation Team. This role requires you to keep detailed records, enter data, audit devices, and pair and install software applications on devices, among other tasks. You will need to be extremely organized, detail\-oriented, and tech\-savvy to be successful in this role. Training on device setup will be provided.  

  

**Work Location:**Mountain View, CA (On\-site role, 5 days/week)  

**Duration:** 6\-month contract with potential to extend depending on your performance  

**Pay Range:**$25 \- 34/hr  

  

**Responsibilities:*** Coordinate logistics, tracking, receipt, dispensing, and reconciliation of investigational products and device supplies required for clinical trials.
* Support the clinical study team with study materials, office supplies, tracking, and management.
* Document coordination \- creates and manages the clinical study files and oversees the organization and distribution of clinical study documents.
* Assist in clinical study startup activities such as preparation and dispatch of site binders and tools
* Provide administrative support to the team, including organizing logistics for events and key team meetings
* Assist with preparation for periodic audits of clinical study files for completeness and accuracy.
* Assist with study equipment and device setup (pairing devices, app installation, etc.)
* Applies and maintains clear identification labels on all devices for inventory tracking.
* Maintains detailed logs of lab inventories. Keep detailed records of incoming and outgoing shipments.
* Comply with the client's device audits.
* Maintains the physiological data collection lab, keeping an organized, clean, and safe working environment.
* Regularly organizes lab facilities and equipment storage areas.
* Submits purchase requests and logs purchases in a budget Excel sheet.
* Performs light clerical activities like printing, stapling, and filing.
* Position requires regular physical activity including standing, bending, and lifting of equipment and supply boxes
* Maintain good clinical practice, following applicable health and safety principles and practices.

**Requirements:*** **3\-5 years of work experience** with **1\+ years of prior office experience**
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree preferred
* **Minimum Degree Required:** Completed High School (Diploma or GED)
* Relevant experience **supporting clinical studies** with hands\-on involvement preferred
* Experience with **inventory management** and **Laboratory operations**
* Strong attention to detail.
* Self\-starter willing to help, capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* **Tech\-savvy with devices**
* **PC and Smartphone App** (Android and iOS) skills
* Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); and other applicable applications

  

Thank you!

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Project Coordinator / Program Coordinator – Hardware Test Systems \& NPI**

**Location\- Santa Clara, CA (Onsite)**

**Job type\- Full time**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Project Coordinator to support the development and deployment of complex hardware tester systems used in manufacturing and validation environments. The role will coordinate multiple PCBAs, mechanical assemblies, cables, connectors, and system\-level components through the full hardware lifecycle, including material readiness, build planning, system integration, bring\-up, validation, and production readiness. This position requires strong experience in PCBA\-based hardware programs, BOM and material management, cross\-functional coordination, and issue tracking across engineering, operations, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end execution of hardware tester system programs consisting of multiple PCBAs, mechanical parts, cables, connectors, power components, and system accessories.
* Track program milestones from concept, NPI, and prototype builds through validation and production readiness.
* Manage board\-level and system\-level BOM readiness, material availability, and part number tracking.
* Drive hardware build planning and execution across multiple boards and subsystems simultaneously.
* Partner with Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Validation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and external suppliers to resolve issues and maintain schedules.
* Track engineering changes, material shortages, build risks, and dependency blockers.
* Monitor build status, integration readiness, bring\-up activities, validation progress, and issue closure.
* Maintain program dashboards, action item trackers, risk registers, and executive status reporting.
* Coordinate supplier and manufacturing partner activities to ensure material and build readiness.
* Facilitate regular cross\-functional meetings and drive accountability for deliverables and action items.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related technical field.
* 3\+ years of experience in hardware program management, project coordination, NPI operations, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience supporting PCBA\-based products, server platforms, test systems, or hardware infrastructure programs.
* Strong understanding of BOM structures, hardware part numbering systems, material planning, and engineering change processes.
* Experience managing multiple board builds and system integration activities concurrently.
* Ability to interpret and track hardware assemblies, PCBAs, mechanical components, cables, and subsystem dependencies.
* Proficiency with project management tools, spreadsheets, and issue tracking systems.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting tester, fixture, validation, manufacturing, or datacenter hardware programs.
* Familiarity with hardware part numbering and BOM structures (e.g., board assemblies, system assemblies, manufacturing BOMs, and engineering BOMs).
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and hardware suppliers.
* Understanding of NPI, prototype, EVT/DVT/PVT, or manufacturing build processes.
* Experience coordinating material readiness, build execution, and validation activities in a fast\-paced hardware environment.

**Key Skills**

* Hardware NPI Program Management
* PCBA Program Coordination
* System Integration Readiness
* BOM \& Material Management
* Build Planning \& Execution
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Supplier \& Manufacturing Coordination
* Validation \& Bring\-Up Tracking
* Schedule \& Milestone Management

Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $124,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world\-renowned care begins with world\-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family\-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state\-of\-the\-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team \- like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  

  

**Job ID:** LP\_011096\-2240

 **Job Description** **JOB SUMMARY**


This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.


The Translation Program Coordinator is responsible for developing, coordinating and managing translation services, for training and assessment of staff, interns and volunteers for translation services. Conducts medical and general interpreting/translating for staff, patients, and families for Stanford Health Services and other contracting institutions. Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.


Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.


Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

* Coordinates workflow of all translation assignments, including delegating translation assignments and ensuring successful completion of all assigned projects.
* Develops policies, financial planning and organization of the translation program.
* Edits all translations providing feedback to the translation team including monitoring the translators' performance and providing feedback.
* Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.
* Handles requests for translations from external customers including other hospitals, pharmaceutical companies and outside institutions.
* Communicates and manages the procedure, payment, and delivery timeframe.
* Coordinates with outside contractors for certain languages and establishes working relationships with contractors and vendors.
* Responsible for invoicing, billing and collection upon delivery of final product for external customers.
* Handles requests for translations from the hospital units and clinics and assigns work orders to in house translators.
* Must possess high verbal and written skills in both English and the appropriate language.
* Organizes educational translation meetings and prepares presentations on translation topics such as grammar, punctuation, medical terminology, etc) in staff meetings.
