**Job Announcement**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides education, leadership development, behavioral health, intervention, street outreach, and workforce development services to San Francisco youth and their families. CYC envisions empowering young people to reach their highest potential as individuals and to develop a positive self/cultural identity. Our mission is to empower and strengthen a diverse population of high\-need youth and their families by providing comprehensive youth development through education, employment training, advocacy, and other supportive services.

 **Title:** **Program Specialist \- Transition Opportunities and Programs for Success (TOPS)**

**Salary:****$26 \- $30 per hour**

**Reports to:****Program Manager**

**Status:****Full\-Time (40 hours/week); Non\-Exempt**

 **POSITION DESCRIPTION**


CYC's Transition Opportunities and Programs for Success (TOPS) Program focuses on uplifting and motivating youth ages 14\-24 with limited English language skills.


Under the supervision of the Program Manager, the TOPS Transitional Age Program Coordinator will be responsible for provide youth who are English Language Learners with case management, job and college readiness skills development, social emotional support, and acculturation guidance.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

* Develop curriculum and facilitate job and college readiness skills training workshops.
* Providing personal and vocational guidance for youth using vocational and interest assessments, and developing individualized vocational goals and plans with participants
* Support college/corporate tours for high school and TAY students to explore successfully transition to post\-secondary education and employment opportunities.
* Providing case management and referral service to high\-need youth and young adults, assisting with job placement
* Counseling participants in resolving personal issues that may affect work/school performance
* Maintain up\-to\-date list of available transferable credits to a 4 years’ college and jobs that are appropriate for participants
* Cultivate relationships with CCSF, EOPS providing college preparation advising
* Convene a community service\-learning project
* Support and facilitate activities at summer boot camp
* Track and report all program outcome and activities via data management system
* Complete all required written documentation and reports
* Refer youth to appropriate services within CYC or other agencies
* Support agency\-wide community events and initiatives.
* Other duties as assigned by management

**QUALIFICATIONS:**
===================

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (or currently pursuing degree with relevant experience).
* Two years of experience working with youth, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Experience in facilitating meetings, workshops, and providing 1:1 support to youth and young adults.
* Ability to work with ethnically of low\-income youth and TAY as well as English language learners to provide social and emotional support.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Ability to work as part of a team to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bilingual in English AND **Cantonese/Mandarin language is REQUIRED**.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Good organizational and project management skills.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college to career education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends

***\*\*This position requires flexibility to work across various UCSF Medical Center locations, including UCSF Cancer Center in Berkeley and Burlingame.*** *\*\**

The Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) Clinical Research Network Office is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to support the clinical research programs at our UCSF partner sites. The CRC will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager (CRM), Operations Manager, and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF, and regulating agency policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules, and assist the CRM and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Institutional Review Board online systems, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


**Department Summary:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).


The HDFCCC integrates the work of researchers and clinicians dedicated to four fundamental pursuits: laboratory research into the causes of cancer progression; clinical research to translate new knowledge into viable treatments; compassionate, state\-of\-the\-art patient care; and population research that can lead to improvements in prevention, early detection, and quality\-of\-life for those living with cancer. The twin pillars of precision medicine and precision population health guide research and treatment at HDFCCC.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Experience in clinical research or demonstrated research or training experience that translates into a clinical research setting
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments, and outside institutions; and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of research, especially in the areas of biological sciences
* Experience with various computer program (Microsoft Office; internet\-based databases) and using specialized software such as OnCore
* Ability to sit and work at a computer for several hours per day; may need to travel between one or more campuses via UCSF shuttle; ability to stand for several hours of the day
* Working knowledge of federal, state, and local research; regulations and guidelines, and research practice methods in a laboratory or clinical setting
* Ability to apply relevant information to the assessment, required interpretation, and processing of medical data
Ability to independently interpret and apply policies, respond to requests, resolve issues, and provide assistance to faculty and staff at all levels in a team\-oriented environment  
* 

Preferred Qualifications:


* Fluency in the usage of IRB online system, iRIS, for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Certification by the Society of Clinical Research Associates or the Association of Clinical Research Professionals
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of location specific and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Ability to work with a sensitive population of patients (oncology patients)
* Prior analytical and writing skills in a science/research environment
* Knowledge of clinical research in oncology
* Knowledge and experience in managing oncology clinical trials
* Membership in a clinical research professional society
* Knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing / shipping infectious substance

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Broccoli**  



At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.


We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.


Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.


Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.


Today:

* Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.
* We've grown to **$15M\+ ARR in under two years.**
* We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.
* We're backed by **Khosla Ventures** and **Y Combinator**.


We're still just getting started.  

  

**The Role**


Broccoli is looking for a People Operations Coordinator to serve as the right hand to our Director of People. This person will be the glue that holds our day\-to\-day people operations together — owning the details that make our employees feel taken care of, while also handling core HR administrative work. This is a great fit for someone who thrives on variety, loves being the go\-to person for questions, and wants to help build culture at a growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own employee engagement and recognition programs — planning, coordinating, and executing initiatives that build culture and celebrate our team
* Lead the new hire onboarding experience end\-to\-end: preparing workspaces before day one, greeting new hires at the door, and making sure their first days feel welcoming and organized
* Manage new hire swag inventory and prep — ensuring swag is stocked, prepped ahead of new hire start dates, and sent out in time for arrival
* Help coordinate device and equipment setup for new employees, including ordering desks, monitors, and other workstation needs
* Own new hire checklist completion — tracking progress and following up directly with new hires on outstanding onboarding items
* Handle core HR administrative tasks, including sending offer letters and maintaining accurate employee records
* Run regular HR reports and pull data as needed to support the Director of People and leadership
* Serve as a point of contact for HR questions, escalating to the Director of People as needed
* Partner directly with the Director of People on ongoing HR projects and initiatives
* Act as a champion of in\-office culture — keeping our SF office running smoothly and looking for ways to make it a great place to work
* Support general HR administrative needs as they come up — this role is a true catchall for People Ops

**What We're Looking For**

* 1\-3 years of experience in HR/People Operations
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail — able to juggle multiple projects simultaneously
* A warm, welcoming presence — someone who genuinely enjoys being the face of the office and making people feel taken care of
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Familiar with Rippling as an HRIS system, and comfortable using AI tools to build workflows and improve processes
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset — someone who spots what needs to get done and does it, rather than waiting to be asked
* Discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive employee information

*Broccoli is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe great teams are built by people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.*


Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

The James Irvine Foundation is a private, nonprofit grantmaking foundation dedicated to expanding opportunity for the people of California. The Foundation’s current focus is a California where all low\-income workers have the power to advance economically. jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator - San Francisco
jobs.description:
At HOKALI, we simplify how schools book, organize, and manage after\-school programs and camps. Our platform helps schools find and book a wide variety of onsite programs to supplement learning and enrich students' extracurricular experiences. We believe every child deserves the opportunity to explore their interests and reach their full potential.


About the Role
We are looking for a detail\-oriented **Logistics Coordinator (Part\-Time)** to oversee our inventory, material distribution, and site supply operations. In this role, you will manage gear, uniforms, and educational supplies from receipt to final site delivery across the SF Bay Area.


You will be responsible for receiving shipments, maintaining an organized storage facility, building program packages, and ensuring all materials reach our partner school sites efficiently.


Key Responsibilities* Inventory \& Storage Management: Receive, inspect, organize, and properly label all incoming inventory, program materials, and staff uniforms at our central storage facility.
* Stock Tracking \& Records: Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date inventory records and log all incoming/outgoing items.
* Kitting \& Package Assembly: Assemble, pack, and prepare welcome kits, uniforms, and site\-specific material packages according to program needs.
* Distribution \& Shipping: Coordinate shipments via carriers (UPS/FedEx) or personally deliver supplies directly to partner school sites as needed.
* Regional Logistics Coverage: Manage supply operations across the SF Bay Area / Oakland, with scheduled site/storage visits to San Jose approximately once per month.
* Internal Communication: Coordinate closely with operations teams via Slack and track hours using TriNet.


Schedule \& Compensation* Type: Part\-Time (Flexibility based on weekly operational volume).
* Schedule: Estimated 4–8 hours per week (flexible scheduling).
* Compensation: $28 – $32 / hour \+ Mileage Reimbursement for personal vehicle usage (or $35 / hour flat rate inclusive of travel).
* Locations: SF Bay Area / Oakland (with monthly travel to San Jose).

 **Requirements**  

* Reliable Personal Vehicle (Required): Must have a valid driver’s license, active auto insurance, and a clean driving record to transport and deliver materials/boxes between sites.
* Physical Capability: Ability to lift, carry, and move boxes and equipment weighing up to 40 lbs.
* Prior experience in warehouse management, inventory control, or field logistics preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills and high attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and maintain organized records.
* Proficiency with digital tools (Slack, spreadsheets, shipping platforms).

  

**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation.
* Flexible scheduling aligned with your availability and operational needs.
* Access to the HOKALI Academy—a community space designed for educators to learn, connect, and collaborate.
* Structured lesson plans provided, with room to bring your own creative ideas to class.
* Opportunities for professional growth and expanded responsibilities within HOKALI.
* Employee Referral Program with bonus incentives.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Generalist**
====================


At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done.


We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world.


The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness).


We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

### **About the Role**


At Generalist, we build foundation models for the physical world. Across our team in San Mateo and Boston, we know that our company’s future is shaped entirely by the people who join us. That’s why we care deeply about making every candidate feel welcomed, valued, and respected from their very first conversation to their very first day on the job.


As our Recruiting Coordinator, you’ll be the heart of that candidate experience!


You will serve as our operational anchor, bringing warmth, organization, and clarity to interview scheduling, candidate communication, and overall hiring logistics. Sitting at the intersection of every team at Generalist, you'll play a vital role in building our culture and company.


You will be in the San Mateo office five days a week.

**Here’s what you’ll be doing:**

* Lead the scheduling of all interview stages — from initial chats and screens to full on\-sites — across San Mateo, Boston, and candidate time zones using Ashby.
* Be the main guide and friendly contact for candidates throughout their journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels thoughtful, well\-organized, and seamless.
* Coordinate travel and expenses for visiting candidates, ensuring flights, hotel stays, ground transit, and reimbursements are effortless for them.
* Keep Ashby running smoothly and reliably — maintaining stage accuracy, interview plans, email templates, direct\-booking links, and interviewer training records.
* Support interviewer balance across our team by distributing schedules fairly and flagging early when we need to expand our interviewer pool.
* Keep pipelines flowing effortlessly by spotting potential bottlenecks, resolving delays, and troubleshooting scheduling conflicts proactively.
* Partner on offer logistics — from background checks and Ashby offer packets to sending personalized welcome notes and swag — ensuring a delightful handoff to HR and IT for day one.
* Treat candidate privacy with utmost care and discretion at every step of the process.
* Continuously refine our recruiting tools, templates, and workflows to make our interview operations increasingly efficient and candidate\-friendly.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have 1\+ year(s) coordinating interviews at volume, or comparable experience — an EA supporting several executives, or an operations role where you owned complex multi\-party scheduling and the consequences of getting it wrong.
* Have worked in Ashby and know its scheduling, interview plans, templates, and interviewer pools well enough to have opinions about how they should be set up.
* Write unusually well in short forms. A reschedule email from you makes a candidate feel taken care of rather than processed, and a note to a hiring manager tells them exactly what you need in three lines.
* Are precise by disposition. Names spelled correctly, links tested before they are sent, time zones right the first time, and no interview that starts with five minutes of confusion.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and adjust quickly when schedules shift, candidates re\-route, or hiring needs change.
* Genuine customer service orientation – you treat every candidate, hiring manager, and interviewer like the most important person in your inbox.
* Interest in a long\-term career in People, Talent, or HR – with curiosity about how recruiting operations scale as a company grows.
* Are energized by being in the office five days a week and want to be in the room on the days that matter.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Pediatrics Research
jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI) in the Department of Pediatrics; may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.  



The CRC’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Institutional Review Board (IRB) online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols.
  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines  
* 

Preferred Qualifications:


* Fluent in Spanish
* BA/BS degree with biology coursework included
* Two years experience in a clinical research setting
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of medical terminology, and/or the ability to apply information to the assessment, interpretation, and processing of medical data
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:
	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
	+ The Protection of Human Research Subjects
	+ CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
	+ Effective Cash Handling Procedures
	+ Environmental Health and Safety Training
	+ Fire Safety Training

The Sales \& Events Coordinator supports the Sales and Marketing Department, and the primary responsibility is to support the sales team in generating revenue and driving business growth for the hotel, while also coordinating group and event servicing functions. This involves assisting with the coordination and execution of sales activities, such as responding to inquiries, preparing proposals, facilitating bookings for meetings, events, and serving as a point of contact for all client services and accommodation. This role also supports the planning and execution of group and event programs, including coordination of event details, documentation, and on\-site servicing.


**Key Responsibilities:**


*Sales \& Lead Inquiries*

* Check inquiries for duplicate accounts and keep records accurate.
* Route leads to the appropriate Sales Manager for follow\-up.

* Technologically savvy, with a working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Delphi, and Opera Cloud preferred.


**Background Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or certification in sales, business administration, or related field.
* 2\-4 years’ administrative support experience in hospitality, entertainment and/or public relations is preferred.
* Outstanding customer service skills
* Able to work independently and as part of a team.


Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, employees may be required to work varying schedules (including Holidays and weekends) to reflect the business needs of the hotel.

jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews.


Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

  

The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity.

  

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.


The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.


We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own adoption, retention, and growth across a mature portfolio of 100–200\+ accounts in our Scaled segment — and you'll build the systems that make covering a book that size possible.


You'll determine the right signals, automate analysis and follow\-ups, and design an operating model that gives customers an excellent experience. Roughly 70% of your time will be portfolio management; the other 30% will be building the infrastructure and process behind it — working closely with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.


This is a foundational hire. The health scoring, playbooks, and operating cadences you build will be the ones the team runs on for years, and you'll help define what "Scaled" means at Outset as the segment grows.

**Responsibilities**

* Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across a portfolio of 100–200\+ Scaled accounts, from onboarding through renewal
* Keep usage and adoption high in a deliberately lower\-touch model — leverage programs, automation, and self\-service before reaching for a calendar invite
* Monitor account health and usage signals to catch risk and expansion opportunities early, and prioritize where your direct time actually changes the outcome
* Run renewals across a mixed model of actively managed and auto\-renewing accounts, partnering with our broader CS team on commercial approach
* Build and run one\-to\-many programs: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in\-product guidance, documentation, and templated success plans
* Develop our account health tracking methodology from the ground up — what signals matter, how they're weighted, how they trigger action, and how we know the scoring is predictive
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering to build the infrastructure behind scaled CS: usage instrumentation, alerting, lifecycle triggers, and automated follow\-up
* Design the operational cadence for this segment: what regular communication looks like, how issues route to and from Product Support, and what escalation looks like. (Product Support owns ticket resolution. You own the process around it).
* Build reporting in Hex and with other AI tools that gives the business real visibility into Scaled segment health, adoption, and retention
* Translate portfolio\-wide patterns into prioritized input for Product

**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years in customer success, account management, CS operations, sales, or lifecycle/growth, including a high\-volume portfolio
* Experience building scaled or digital CS programs from scratch, or working as one of the first hires in a scaled CS role
* Technically fluent and self\-sufficient with data: product analytics and usage, pulling data with AI tools, and building tooling with AI
* Hands\-on with a modern GTM and support stack. Ours is Pylon, Hex, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Claude; we lean heavily on AI day to day and expect you to as well
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Series A/B/C or fast\-paced SaaS experience, with a proactive, ownership\-driven approach to ambiguity

**Nice to have**

* Experience defining or re\-segmenting a customer base, or standing up a support model for a new segment
* Background in customer marketing, growth, or RevOps
* Familiarity with research operations or market research


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

jobs.title: Public Relations Strategist
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Delta, founded in 1971, is a global leader in switching power supplies and thermal management products, with a thriving portfolio of smart energy\-saving systems and solutions in industrial automation, building automation, telecom power, data center infrastructure, EV charging, renewable energy, energy storage, and display technologies.
Guided by its mission, “To provide innovative, clean and energy\-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow,” Delta leverages its expertise in high\-efficiency power electronics and its ESG\-embedded business model to address key environmental challenges, including climate change.
Delta serves customers through its sales offices, R\&D centers, and manufacturing facilities across close to 200 locations on five continents.
Key Responsibilities:
**About the Role**
Delta is seeking a Public Relations Strategist to help strengthen its reputation, thought leadership, and media visibility across the Americas.
This is a hands\-on, senior individual\-contributor role responsible for developing messaging, shaping narratives, and executing strategic PR programs aligned with Delta’s business and marketing priorities.
The Public Relations Strategist will work closely with business and marketing teams, executives, technical experts, headquarters corporate communications, and external PR agencies to identify compelling stories and secure relevant media opportunities.
The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with a keen understanding of market trends and media interests. This individual should recognize which topics will resonate with the market, understand what journalists need, and translate complex technical information into clear and compelling business narratives. **Messaging and Narrative Development*** Develop clear, differentiated messaging and narratives aligned with Delta’s business objectives, market priorities, and technology leadership.
* Connect Delta’s technologies and solutions with relevant business challenges, customer needs, and industry trends.
* Translate complex technical information into credible and engaging stories for business, technology, and industry audiences.
* Identify meaningful proof points, customer examples, market data, and executive perspectives that strengthen Delta’s stories.
* Maintain consistency across press releases, media pitches, contributed content, interviews, and other external communications.
* Adapt corporate and global messaging for the Americas market while maintaining alignment with Delta’s overall brand and positioning.

**Media Relations and Storytelling*** Build and maintain relationships with research companies, business, technology, and industry trade media.
* Develop timely story ideas and proactively pitch relevant journalists, editors, and podcast hosts.
* Respond to media inquiries and coordinate interviews with Delta executives and subject\-matter experts.
* Draft and edit press releases, media pitches, contributed articles, talking points, briefing materials, FAQs, and other communications content.
* Identify opportunities for Delta to contribute to relevant market and industry conversations.
* Maintain an understanding of journalists’ interests, editorial priorities, and evolving media appetites.

**PR Program Execution*** Develop and execute PR plans supporting Delta’s business and marketing priorities.
* Support product and solution introductions, corporate announcements, strategic partnerships, customer stories, and industry events.
* Identify opportunities for media interviews, contributed articles, podcasts, awards, speaking engagements, and executive thought leadership.
* Monitor business developments, market trends, competitor activity, and media coverage to identify relevant storytelling opportunities.
* Maintain media lists, PR calendars, project timelines, and communications materials.
* Manage multiple PR initiatives and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

**Executive Communications and Agency Direction*** Prepare executives and subject\-matter experts for media interviews, podcasts, and other external engagements.
* Develop interview briefs, key messages, talking points, and Q\&A materials.
* Provide strategic direction to external PR agencies for individual announcements, campaigns, and thought\-leadership initiatives.
* Partner with agencies to determine the strongest narrative, media strategy, target outlets, and outreach approach for each PR initiative.
* Challenge and refine agency recommendations to ensure strategies are relevant, differentiated, and aligned with Delta’s business goals.
* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for Delta’s external PR agencies.
* Review agency\-developed strategies and materials for quality, accuracy, and alignment with Delta’s messaging.
* Coordinate agency assignments, deliverables, timelines, and performance reporting.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Work with business units, product marketing, sales, digital marketing, social media, events, legal, and headquarters corporate communications.
* Gather input from business leaders and technical experts to develop accurate and compelling communications.
* Coordinate internal reviews and approvals for press releases and other external materials.

jobs.title: Lead Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------


We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to provide strategic and operational support to the Chief Administrative Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and General Counsel. This role is central to driving operational excellence, fostering company culture, and enabling strategic decision\-making across OpenGov's executive leadership team.


The ideal candidate will be a proactive, culturally\-attuned partner who excels at managing complex executive priorities while serving as a cultural bridge across the organization. You'll coordinate high\-impact events, offsites, and initiatives that strengthen OpenGov's culture and engagement, while simultaneously managing the sophisticated logistics of supporting three senior executives in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.


This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants to amplify impact beyond traditional admin work. You'll be instrumental in shaping how leadership connects with the organization, how key decisions get made, and how our people experience OpenGov's values.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------


Executive Support \& Strategic Partnership

* Multi\-Executive Calendar \& Inbox Management: Proactively manage complex calendars for the CAO, CFO, and GC across multiple time zones and business priorities. Anticipate scheduling conflicts, suggest trade\-offs, and block time strategically to protect focus on highest\-impact work.
* Executive Coordination \& Alignment: Serve as a key connective node between the three executives and across organizational departments. Facilitate seamless communication, flag misalignments early, and help drive execution on shared priorities.
* Meeting Preparation \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive briefing materials, agendas and presentations for team meetings. Take detailed notes during key discussions, clearly document action items with owners and deadlines, and ensure follow\-through on commitments.
* Travel Management: Plan domestic and international travel itineraries for executives and leadership team. Handle logistics including accommodations, ground transportation, visa coordination, and real\-time adjustments. Leverage AI tools to optimize travel planning and expense reporting.
* Process Optimization \& Documentation: Identify opportunities to streamline recurring processes (meeting cadences, approvals, communications). Document processes and maintain operational playbooks that scale as the company grows.


Culture \& Events Leadership


Culture Events \& Execution: Help support company all hands meetings, happy hours and other internal events, working cross functionally with partners in Workplace and HR.

NYCHA has implemented a Zone Model approach, which leverages NYCHA’s and partner resources to expand economic opportunity for public housing residents through place\-based service coordination. Through this new approach, REES enables NYCHA to (1\) Generate more economic opportunities for NYCHA residents and NYCHA neighborhoods, while strategically investing and leveraging NYCHA’s spend; (2\) Provide a more comprehensive economic empowerment platform with additional capacities around financial literacy, asset building and business development; (3\) Reduce the duplication of services – better investing limited resources; (4\) Enable NYCHA to be a better partner to community\-based organizations, government agencies, philanthropies, community colleges, schools, employers and other key stakeholders; and (5\) Drive more resources and investment into public housing neighborhoods.

7\. Attend internal and external meetings with various administering departments and key stakeholders. Make recommendations on policies and procedures.
  

8\. Represent REES at occasional evening meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  

  

Additional Information
  

  

1\. NYCHA employees applying for transfer, promotional, title or level change opportunities must have served a period of one year at current location and in current title and level (if applicable).
  

2\. NYCHA residents are encouraged to apply.
  

3\. NYCHA provides benefits that include a choice of medical coverage plans, deferred compensation plans and a defined pension benefit plan as a member of the New York City Employees’ Retirement System (NYCERS).
  

  

Please read this posting carefully to make certain you meet the minimum qualification requirements before applying to this position.

1\. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are a managed service provider (MSP) supporting enterprise clients with large\-scale IT fleet operations. We're seeking an IT Asset \& Logistics Coordinator to own the lifecycle of client hardware — primarily laptops and iPads — from procurement and deployment through repurposing and retirement. This role is the operational backbone of our device management: shipping, receiving, cataloging, and tracking thousands of assets while keeping clients informed and coordinating closely with the broader helpdesk team.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing high volume without letting anything slip through the cracks.

\* Note that this is a short\-term 3 month position. This may change depending on future business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ship and receive laptops, iPads, and related IT equipment, ensuring accurate handling at every stage.
* Catalog and tag all incoming and outgoing assets, maintaining clean, accurate records in an asset management platform (e.g., AssetPanda or equivalent).
* Manage the full asset lifecycle — provisioning, deployment, repurposing, and decommissioning — for an enterprise client fleet numbering in the thousands.
* Coordinate logistics, including arranging shipments, rerouting deliveries as needed, and tracking packages through to delivery.
* Proactively update clients on shipment status, timelines, and any exceptions or delays.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in the ticketing system, documenting all asset activity and requests.

**Required Qualifications**

* Prior experience in IT asset management, logistics, inventory, or a related coordination role.
* Familiarity with asset management/tracking software (AssetPanda, Snipe\-IT, ServiceNow, or similar).
* Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., ConnectWise, Autotask, Zendesk, Jira, or equivalent).
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage large volumes accurately.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for client\-facing updates.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a helpdesk/service delivery team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in an MSP or enterprise IT environment.
* Familiarity with shipping/logistics platforms and carrier tracking tools.
* Understanding of device provisioning workflows for Windows and iOS/iPadOS devices.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A\+, ITIL Foundation) a plus

maman \- Digital Marketing \& Content Coordinator


Role based in: New York, NY


Reports to: Digital Marketing \& Content Manager

  

maman is a french bakery, café and leading lifestyle brand founded in 2014 by owners elisa marshall \& benjamin sormonte, with locations across north america and canada. inspired by family traditions, and the highest quality ingredients, maman offers a selection of delicious baked goods {including their famous nutty chocolate chip cookie}, coffee, fresh breakfast, and lunch options spanning from hearty salads \& sandwiches to savory quiches. in addition to hosting intimate events, maman has partnered with leading brands for partnerships and activations. from baby showers and birthday parties to engagements, they're able to help celebrate customers \& make new beautiful memories.


We’re looking for a creative, organized, and digitally savvy Digital Marketing \& Content Coordinator to join our marketing team! Our ideal candidate is a natural storyteller and strong writer who is genuinely excited to make content, engage with our community, and help bring a distinct and engaging voice to maman’s digital channels. They are passionate about social media, hospitality, food, and digital culture, with a strong visual eye and an instinct for turning campaign priorities into social\-first content people want to watch, share, save, and talk about.


Reporting to the Digital Marketing \& Content Manager, this person will be responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of maman’s organic social media channels, with a primary focus on content creation, copywriting, publishing, and community engagement. They will bring broader campaign strategy and messaging to life through Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, captions, and recurring content series, while helping shape maman’s social voice in a way that remains warm, playful, and unmistakably on\-brand. P.S. must love cookies!

  

What you'll do:


SOCIAL MEDIA \& CONTENT CREATION

* Own the day\-to\-day execution of maman’s organic social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Concept, capture, edit, schedule, and publish social content across Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, and recurring series with support from the Digital Marketing \& Content Manager.
* Create short\-form video content in cafés, at events, during store openings, and on set, ensuring footage feels polished, on\-brand, and platform\-native.
* Maintain the social media calendar and ensure all content is published accurately, on time, and aligned with campaign priorities.
* Handle daily community engagement across comments, DMs, tags, mentions, and guest questions.
* Coordinate with local marketing coordinators and café teams to source stories, capture content, and support market\-specific initiatives.
* Maintain an organized library of raw footage, edited content, photography, and approved social assets.

  

COPYWRITING \& BRAND VOICE

* Assist with short\-form video text, scripts, retail product descriptions, ad copy, community responses, and other guest\-facing messaging.
* Ensure all copy reflects maman’s established brand voice and feels clear, thoughtful, and engaging.
* Proofread guest\-facing content for tone, grammar, spelling, links, dates, pricing, location details, and overall accuracy.

  

DIGITAL MARKETING SUPPORT

* Support digital campaigns across social, email, website, app, partnerships, and other digital channels.
* Assist with seasonal launches, partnerships, photoshoots, promotions, events, new\-store openings, and broader brand initiatives.
* Help with email copy, ad copy, website copy, campaign recaps, research, and special projects as needed.

  

What we’re looking for:

* 2–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, digital marketing, or a related field.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating polished iPhone content capture, short\-form video editing, and social\-first storytelling. Experience with Adobe Premiere preferred.
* Experience maintaining a social content calendar and publishing across multiple channels.
* A visual eye and understanding of what makes content feel engaging, polished, and on\-brand.
* Have an understanding of brand voice and the ability to apply it consistently across different platforms.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple drafts, deadlines, and priorities.
* Kind, passionate, curious, collaborative, detail\-oriented, highly accountable, and always willing to lend a hand.

  

Why work with us:

* Join a fast\-growing company committed to not just serving the best cookies and coffee, but building a national lifestyle brand.
* Comprehensive benefits package including healthcare, 401K, commuter benefits \& more.
* Support to help you settle into the role and learning opportunities to broaden your skill set.
* The opportunity to work across social media, content, hospitality, events, partnerships, and community\-building.
* Generous employee discount.
* A collaborative and creative team environment where new ideas are encouraged!
* Great opportunity to progress with maman, with internal mobility and growth encouraged when possible.


Keep in mind that maman is growing and developing every day. We all do a little bit of everything and like to roll up our sleeves to help a colleague out!


We are looking for awesome, hard\-working people that are all about creating the most memorable experience for every single maman customer.  

  

Thank you for your interest in maman and look forward to speaking with you!

jobs.title: Client Relationship Leader (AA)
jobs.description:
Job Description:  

Client Relationship Leaders (CRLs) nurture and cultivate long term client relationships with strategic accounts, building on their deep understanding of the market and robust internal networks to support clients holistically through their end\-to\-end experiences. CRLs serve as the main driver and point of contact to deliver AXA XL’s value proposition, making AXA XL seem big and feel small to the client and the account team. Outstanding business, technical, and people acumen are essential for success in this key role.

**What you’ll be doing**


What will your essential responsibilities include?

**Know Your Client Holistically:**

* Understand client’s business, strategic priorities, industry trends and risks they face.
* Develop proactive client insights and themes to take to clients.
* Understand the underwriting appetite and how it could support client needs.
* Assess and manage business growth and development opportunities.
* Set and track growth and profitability targets at the account level.
* Design strategy and action plan to achieve business goals and drive account plan execution.
* Coordinate account team effectively to ensure high productivity and lead effective meetings.

**Deliver What We Promise:**

* Identify client service needs and customize service arrangements that manage client needs vs. AXA XL cost to serve.
* Identify and navigate appropriate resources and teams within AXA XL and across regions on behalf of clients.
* Remove roadblocks for account team and clients.
* Set resolution plan to address “at risk” client issues and escalate as required.
* Partner with the brokers to address service\-related topics.

**Bring Relevant Products \& Solutions to Clients:**

* Proactively identify growth opportunities.
* Support the cross\-selling process to increase product density.
* Engage clients in risk dialogues to identify their needs and translate them into the right product and service propositions.
* Craft proposals, network internally, and collaborate with account teams to shape pitches.
* Co\-innovate with clients, brokers, and account teams to bring unique services beyond the policy to clients.
* Influence deal terms to balance profitability with client needs and position AXA XL to win Lines of Business (LoBs).
* Deepen broker relationships to understand where business is placed.

**Foster Long Term Relationships:**

* Manage client relationships and know how to collaborate with the account team to meet client expectations.
* Gather and act on client feedback and pursue continuous learning opportunities.
* Create relationship maps and manage engagement with key stakeholders.
* Understand client's buying centers, and how decisions are made.
* Conduct stewardship meetings.
* Invite relevant clients to flagship events, executive sponsor program, and local/regional client council program.


You will report to the Head of Client and Distribution.

**What you will bring**


We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:

**Business**

* Commercial Acumen / Relationship Building: Engages with c\-suite executives and brokers, manages stakeholders and conflict, and negotiates for client interests.
* Business \& Insurance Acumen: Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge, and expertise in the core principles, practices, and dynamics of the insurance industry within the broader context of business.
* Marketing \& Communication: Understands the audience and tailors positioning of communication based on analysis of audience.
* Financial Acumen: Understands and applies insurance financial principles, assessing impacts on bottom\-line and P\&L.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making / Strategic Solutioning: Simplifies complex issues, creates solutions, and uses data to support decision\-making.

**People**

* Customer Centricity: Places customers first; understands and addresses customer needs, while also considering the interests of other stakeholders; ensures customer needs are met to drive business success.
* Leadership People Skills: Empowers others, influences change, inspires with vision, and leads teams to ambitious, collaborative goals.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Leads teams; fosters teamwork; creates opportunities. Build trusted relationships with internal team members.
* Emotional Intelligence /Cultural Awareness: Reads the room and adjusts approach based on people dynamics and cultural differences.

**Technical**

* Business Planning: Set targets, objectives, action plans and manages / monitors action items.
* Industry and Market Knowledge: Understands the inner workings of their client’s businesses and the industries they operate in.
* Technical Product Expertise: Knowledge of global insurance functions and growth trends, using technical expertise to advocate client needs in solution design.

**Who WE are**


AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.  

How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.  

With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.  

Learn more at axaxl.com. **What we OFFER**

**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

The Revenue Operations Analyst will join Epsilon's Revenue Operations team in a foundational support role designed to strengthen day\-to\-day operational support for sales leaders and business partners. This role will help own operational and execution\-oriented responsibilities related to revenue operations, creating clearer focus across the team and enabling business unit partners and functional RevOps leads to stay aligned to their core areas of ownership across business partnership, process design, governance, analytics, and systems implementation.  

  

This is a strong opportunity for someone who is detail\-oriented, organized, comfortable working with data, and interested in building depth in how revenue operations supports sales execution across a complex business. The role will provide hands\-on exposure to CRM data quality, sales process and systems administration, reporting support, intake tracking, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

Sales Leader and Business Partner Support
  

* Provide operational and coordination support to sales leaders and RevOps business unit partners across recurring sales operations activities.
* Help track, organize, and follow up on sales support requests, intake items, and open operational tasks.
* Prepare and maintain recurring materials, trackers, summaries, and status updates used by sales leadership and RevOps stakeholders.

  

CRM, Data Quality, and Process Administration
  

* Assist with CRM data hygiene activities, including identifying missing, outdated, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
* Support maintenance of account, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data according to established RevOps standards.
* Help ensure sales teams are following defined processes, required fields, naming conventions, and data entry expectations.

  

Reporting and Analytics Support
  

* Support recurring sales and pipeline reporting by gathering inputs, validating data, refreshing standard reports, and preparing summaries for review.
* Assist with basic analysis of sales operations data, including pipeline movement, activity tracking, data completeness, and process adherence.
* Partner with Revenue Intelligence and business partners to clarify reporting requests and ensure needed inputs are captured accurately.
* Help document reporting definitions, field usage, and business rules to support consistency across revenue reporting.

  

Documentation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement
  

* Create and maintain documentation for repeatable sales operations processes, support workflows, and RevOps operating procedures.
* Support training and enablement efforts by helping prepare job aids, process guides, checklists, and simple how\-to materials.

  

What Success Looks Like
  

* Sales leaders and business partners receive timely, accurate support on recurring operational needs.
* Operational work is organized, tracked, and completed consistently.
* CRM and sales operations data is complete, accurate, and aligned to established standards.
* Recurring reports, trackers, and process documentation are maintained with strong attention to detail.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, marketing, or a related field.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring tasks accurately and consistently.
* Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and structured processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM and reporting tools quickly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize information clearly.
* Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment.
* Interest in revenue operations, sales operations, business process improvement, or go\-to\-market operations.

  

Preferred  

* Relevant experience through internships, coursework, project work, or prior roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, analytics, finance, or marketing operations.
* Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Experience building or maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, process documentation, or project status updates.
* Familiarity with sales pipeline, forecasting, account management, lead/opportunity workflows, or commercial operations concepts.

  

Ideal Candidate  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who is eager to learn, takes pride in accuracy, and is motivated by improving process, organization, and operational consistency. They are comfortable with operational detail, able to follow and improve repeatable processes, and interested in growing within revenue operations over time. This person should be service\-oriented, dependable, and willing to lean into the details that help sales leaders and business partners work more effectively.  

  

This role can serve as a foundation for growth into the Revenue Operations function. As the analyst builds experience, they may take on more advanced ownership of reporting, process improvement, CRM administration, project coordination, or business unit partnership support.  

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.
  

  

**Additional Information**  

**When you join Epsilon, we'll create something EPIC together.** We're a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30\+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.  

  

Check out a few of these resources to learn more about what makes Epsilon so

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
We believe in the life\-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.


So if you love sports and their community\-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote\-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

**About the Role**


GameChanger is the \#1 youth sports app for live streaming, scorekeeping, and team management. We power millions of games each year, connecting athletes, families, and communities through technology. As we expand across sports—including continued growth in baseball and softball and rapid investment in basketball—we’re building a sales function to accelerate our next phase of growth.


We’re looking for our first Account Manager to join our growing sales organization. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales, you’ll own the customer journey after the initial sale—from a seamless handoff and onboarding through adoption, expansion, and renewal. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to Club Directors and other organization leaders, helping them successfully launch GameChanger across their teams and build lasting value over time.


This is a unique opportunity to help define and scale GameChanger’s account management motion. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Product, and other teams to turn new partnerships into healthy, growing customer relationships while bringing the voice of the customer back into the business.


You’ll focus on two key growth areas:

* **Basketball (B2B2C):** Guiding clubs and organizations from onboarding through sustained adoption across teams, athletes, and families
* **Diamond Sports (B2B):** Retaining and expanding relationships with leagues, tournaments, and organizations in baseball and softball


If you’re energized by building trusted partnerships, thrive in a high\-ownership environment, and enjoy turning customer outcomes into durable business growth, we’d love to meet you.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Post\-Sale Transition \& Onboarding**

* Own the customer relationship from the moment a new agreement is signed, partnering with the Account Executive on a clear handoff.
* Lead onboarding with Club Directors and organization leaders, including account configuration, team setup, stakeholder alignment, and launch planning.
* Create clear success plans, milestones, and responsibilities that help each organization move quickly from signed agreement to active use.
* Equip Club Directors and coaches with the guidance, resources, and communication plans they need to introduce GameChanger to teams and families.

**Drive Adoption \& Account Growth**

* Build trusted, ongoing relationships with Club Directors, league administrators, coaches, and other key stakeholders through regular, proactive check\-ins.
* Monitor customer health and adoption signals—including team setup, coach activation, parent participation, athlete claims, and fan engagement—to identify progress, gaps, and opportunities.
* Develop and execute account plans that increase product adoption, deepen engagement, and expand GameChanger across additional teams, programs, or sports.
* Coordinate targeted education, enablement, and lifecycle communications with Customer Experience and Marketing to help customers achieve their goals.

**Own Retention \& Renewals**

* Own the renewal process for your portfolio, from early planning and value reinforcement through agreement execution.
* Identify risk early, build recovery plans, and mobilize the right internal partners to protect customer outcomes and retention.
* Maintain accurate account health, renewal forecasting, growth opportunities, and customer activity in the CRM.
* Consistently achieve retention, renewal, adoption, and expansion goals.

**Build \& Improve the Account Management Motion**

* Help establish repeatable onboarding, account planning, adoption, expansion, referral and renewal playbooks as the function grows.
* Share customer insights and patterns with Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Product to improve the end\-to\-end customer journey and inform roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Sales leadership to define success metrics, operating rhythms, and scalable processes for account management.

**Who You Are**

* 3–5\+ years of B2B or B2B2C account management, customer success, or post\-sales experience, ideally with responsibility for renewals and expansion.
* Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding retention, renewal, adoption, or growth goals.
* Experience onboarding and managing multi\-stakeholder accounts, from senior decision\-makers to day\-to\-day users.
* Strong consultative, relationship\-building, and executive communication skills, with the ability to connect customer goals to measurable outcomes.
* Comfort using customer data and account health signals to prioritize action and manage a portfolio proactively.
* Experience using CRM and customer success platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar tools.
* Self\-starter who enjoys working in an early\-stage, fast\-paced environment with significant ownership.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the diamond (baseball/softball) and basketball sports markets.
* Prior experience working within the club sports ecosystem is highly preferred.
* Ability to travel on an as\-needed basis.

**Why Join GameChanger**

* Opportunity to help shape the future of the sales organization at a category\-leading product
* Direct impact on growth a

jobs.title: Content and Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

 The Content \& Social Media Manager is responsible for owning Milk Bar’s content machine, building best in class content and community building strategies for Milk Bar’s brand channels. In this role, you will drive Milk Bar’s owned digital content and community strategy, ensuring channel connectivity throughout brand campaigns, messaging, product launches, and more.


You enthusiastically create thumb\-stopping content and engage Milk Bar’s community both on and offline, overseeing and executing interactive content ideation, planning, production, and daily publishing. You are creative and trend\-savvy with a deep understanding of how to thoughtfully connect a brand’s ethos to its customers through social content and communication, in service of brand and business goals.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own Milk Bar’s and Christina Tosi’s content and community strategy, driving strategy, monthly planning, concepting, creative execution and publishing for their social and content ecosystem in support of brand and business objectives
* Lead all social media content production, finely balancing both scrappy, self\-produced content and Creative\-team produced content, with the goal of creating compelling and engaging content to activate Milk Bar’s community. Brief Creative team on an as\-needed basis on specific content needs.
* Lead strategic influencer relations, including relationship nurturing, product comping and providing channel teams strategic recommendations of influencers to leverage (budget depending)
* Serve as an extension of the culinary and R\&D teams, visiting Milk Bar bakeries and R\&D Kitchen (located in Williamsburg) multiple times per week to capture in\-the\-moment happenings; drive Milk Bar’s culinary RTBs in over 50% of content. Partner with Creative team on development of large brand shoot ideas, copy, and visuals tied to launches and marquee brand moments to ensure a strong and unified brand message and experience across all channels
* Respond to daily mentions across platforms; partner with internal Communications and Customer Experience team to maintain brand representation across all social media platforms. Provide a best in class customer experience by providing clear and easy resolutions in a timely and positive manner.
* Leverage social media software and additional industry resources to glean insights to optimize content strategy, drive best\-in\-class engagement, and understand digital trends.
* Function as internal digital trend lead for Brand team, proactively identifying opportunities for real\-time content and engagement in the digital space, and sharing digital \& cultural trends on ongoing basis with team
* Fully understand and exhibit the Milk Bar ethos, embody our core values, inspire celebration and create real magic. Serve as a brand ambassador, both internally and externally.

**Please note that your duties are subject to change at the Company’s discretion.**


Requirements:  

* Bachelor’s degree with focus on business, marketing, communications preferred
* 2\+ years professional experience in a creative or marketing\-focused role
* Working knowledge of and proficiency in iPhone photography, video editing, and Adobe design programs
* Background in the food and beverage or hospitality industry is a plus!
* Experience working in a fast paced, high\-growth startup environment; must be comfortable navigating multiple priorities and building plans from scratch.
* Creative thinker, never satisfied with the status quo and always trying to bring the brand to new levels
* Excellent project and process management and organizational skills, with outstanding attention to detail.
* Collaboration and cross\-functional teamwork: you love working with others and are great at building relationships inside and outside of your department.
* Proactivity and curiosity: you ask questions and challenge the norm.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**City:** New York  

**Department:** Business Development


**Recruiter:** Marcus Gipson

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.



We're looking for a motivated and driven **Business Development Representative** who will be responsible for leading, managing and strengthening relationships with our bus operator partners, ensuring long\-term success, and identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion. The Business Development Representative will also be responsible for sourcing new partners to work with Flix.



This role demands a strategic thinker with a proven track record in business development, adept at navigating complex negotiations and fostering long\-term relationships.


**About the Role**


* Manage and nurture relationships with existing partners, ensuring mutual growth and profitability
* Identify and secure new partnerships with intercity bus operators and other relevant stakeholders to expand Flix's presence in the US East region
* Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes, informing strategic decisions
* Work closely with internal teams, including Network Planning, Operations, Finance, and Marketing, to ensure cohesive strategy execution
* Develop processes and coordinate a variety of projects, making sure the interactions between departments are fluid and results are delivered in a timely manner
* Analyze and optimize partner performance using data\-driven insights, collaborating with internal teams to adjust network strategy and maximize profitability
* Serve as a Flix ambassador at industry events, conferences, and meetings, enhancing brand visibility and credibility


**About You**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Communications or a related field
* 3\-5 years of experience in an externally facing role (business development, sales, account management, consulting or strategic roles)
* Full of ambition, not afraid of rapid change, and able to deal with ambiguity
* Strong analytical abilities, strong negotiation skills, excellent communication skills, proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making and capable of building strong relationships with various types of companies and stakeholders
* Entrepreneurial mindset, self\-motivated, and capable of working autonomously to achieve ambitious targets
* Willingness to travel, up to 20% of time


*Salary Range: $85,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00* *USD*



We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Comprehensive Wellness Coverage**\- Competitive Medical, Vision, and Dental plans, including multiple FSAs (Health and Dependent Care).
* **401(k) Matching**– 401(k) plan with up to 4% company matching contributions.
* **Flexible Time Off**\- Take time off when you need it, as you need it, subject to business needs and manager approval.
* **Paid Parental Leave**\- 8 weeks of fully paid leave to support new parents and growing families.
* **Company Paid Life Insurance**– Basic company\-paid life insurance equal to your annual salary.
* **Lifestyle Spending Account** – Receive up to $600 per year for eligible lifestyle\-related services.
* **Tuition Support**\- Up to $5,250 per year reimbursed for your continued education and development after 12 months of continuous service.
* **24/7 Employee Assistance Program**\- Free, confidential support for mental health, legal, financial, and family issues, including up to 5 free counseling sessions per year.
* **Free Travel Perks**– Complimentary travel on FlixBus and Greyhound for you, family, and friends.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere** \- Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location,



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
