jobs.description:
**Manufacturer’s Sales Representative**

**Outside Sales Representative – New Territory Development**

Stonehenge US

Stonehenge US is looking for a motivated Outside Sales Representative to help develop new business and expand our dealer network throughout Pennsylvania, Delaware, and surrounding markets.

This is a true business\-development position. We already have established sales territories throughout New Jersey and New York, and this position will focus primarily on identifying, scouting, opening, and developing new dealer accounts in markets where we are looking to grow.

Our products include natural stone veneer, manufactured stone, thin brick, bluestone, limestone and step treads, porcelain pavers, artificial grass, outdoor living products, solar paver lights, iron doors, and other building and hardscape products.

**Compensation \& Schedule**

* $70,000 base salary
* Commission of approximately $12,000 for every $1 million in sales
* Monday through Friday
* Approximately 45 hours per week
* Full\-time position
* Primarily field\-based outside sales

This is a developing territory, so we understand that it will take time to build relationships, open dealers, and grow the sales volume. The base salary provides stability while the territory is being developed, with additional earning potential as sales grow.

**Company\-Provided Vehicle \& Equipment**

Stonehenge US provides the tools needed to operate effectively in the field, including:

* Company Ford F\-150
* Company gas card
* Company E\-ZPass
* Company cell phone
* Company iPad
* Product samples, catalogs, promotional materials, and other sales tools
* Company\-paid normal business travel expenses

**Territory \& Location**

Stonehenge US’s main warehouse and office is located in Staten Island, New York, but this position will spend the majority of its time in the field developing new business throughout Pennsylvania, Delaware, and surrounding markets.

Because of the territory, a candidate located in or near our Staten island warehouse or South Jersey particularly areas such as Cherry Hill, Marlton, Voorhees, Maple Shade, Mount Laurel, or surrounding areas would be well positioned for this role, with convenient access to Philadelphia, southeastern Pennsylvania, Delaware, and New Jersey.

The salesperson will also need to travel to our Staten Island location periodically for meetings, training, samples, promotional materials, and other sales needs.

The position is not limited to South Jersey candidates. We are primarily looking for the right person who is comfortable traveling throughout the territory and actively developing new markets.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Researching and identifying new masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, building material, lumber, and related dealers
* Scouting new markets throughout Pennsylvania and Delaware
* Cold calling and scheduling meetings with owners, purchasers, managers, and other decision\-makers
* Visiting prospective dealers and learning their existing product mix and suppliers
* Identifying where Stonehenge US products can solve a problem or fill a gap
* Developing relationships from the first introduction through the first order and beyond
* Presenting products, pricing, displays, samples, and dealer programs
* Creating and managing sales opportunities and follow\-up
* Developing new accounts into consistent long\-term customers
* Planning efficient daily routes and managing your territory independently
* Working with our Sales Manager and internal team when assistance is needed on larger opportunities

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable building a territory rather than simply maintaining an existing customer list.

The right person should be:

* Self\-motivated
* Organized
* Persistent
* Comfortable cold calling and walking into new businesses
* Able to research and qualify prospects independently
* Comfortable speaking with owners, purchasers, and decision\-makers
* Able to plan productive routes and manage time efficiently
* Comfortable following opportunities from the first conversation through the sale
* Able to recognize when an opportunity is worth continuing to pursue and when it is time to move on

Experience in building materials, masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, stone, pavers, construction products, or contractor sales is strongly preferred, although we will consider candidates with strong outside B2B sales experience.

This position requires regular travel throughout the assigned market, particularly Pennsylvania and Delaware, so the candidate should be comfortable spending most working days in the field.

**About Stonehenge US**

Stonehenge US is a growing supplier and manufacturer of masonry, hardscape, and outdoor\-living products serving building\-material dealers throughout the Northeast.

We are continuing to expand our dealer network and are looking for someone who wants the opportunity to build a territory, develop long\-term dealer relationships, and grow their income as the territory grows.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an SDR who has lived the reality of working in schools. This role is the front door of our sales motion: you’ll open conversations with district HR leaders and their teams, build genuine relationships across district offices, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. Your credibility as someone who has been in the building and understands what it means when a classroom or cafeteria is short\-staffed is what will set you apart.

Required

* Genuine comfort and energy on the phone; you’d rather have ten real conversations than send a hundred emails

* Strong self\-direction: you can take a territory or target list and independently figure out who to call and why
* Clear, simple, communication style, with the discipline to keep messages short and relevant

jobs.description:
**Title:** Operations Coordinator
  
**Program:** Empire Men’s Shelter
  
**Salary Range:** $49,350 per year
  
  

**Program Description:**  

The Shelter is a 110 bed, 24/7 emergency shelter for general population homeless men that are employable or are already employed. Our comprehensive services include case management, occupational therapy, workforce development services, and housing placement assistance.
  
  

**Overall Responsibilities:**  

Under the general direction of the Assistant Director, with latitude for independent action, the Operations Coordinator directs a staff of Residential Aides assigned to the 4p\-12am and 12am\-8am shifts, in providing direct assistance to the clients in adhering to the rule and regulations of the shelter; performs related work.
  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

The essential duties of the Operations Coordinator include but are not limited to the following activities:
  
* Supervise Residential Aides and Senior Residential Aides assigned to the 4pm\-12am and 12am\-8am shifts to ensure the safety and smooth operation of the shelter.
* Assists the Assistant Director in overseeing departmental tasks and goals as well as overall facility operations.
* Serve as lead manager in the absence of more senior managers.
* Proved wrap\-around overtime coverage as needed.
* Perform crisis intervention when required which includes handling Priority One incidents for Kenton Hall while on\-site.
* Participate in the design and implementation of program improvements, policies, procedures and other strategic planning efforts.
* Provide emergency first aid/CPR assistance when needed.
* Keeps records and assists staff in updating the client data summary sheets used for weekly/monthly meetings.
* Maintains an updated filing system so files can be easily retrieved and ensures that record keeping criteria are followed.
* Provides training of staff through on\-site sessions as well as referrals to outside training sources.
* Provides orientation for new arrivals, informing them of shelter rules and regulations, giving them a tour of the facility, assigning a locker and a bed, and giving them their basic supplies, including sheets, towels and toiletries.
* Participates in case conferences in response to client complaints, using conflict resolution techniques to amicably resolve issues.
* Performs other duties as assigned by the Assistant and Program Directors


**Qualifications:**  

* Associates Degree plus experience as outlined in item 1 below, or
* H.S. Diploma or GED plus experience as outlined in item 2 below or
* Bachelor’s Degree
* Fire Guard certification F\-02 or Fire Safety Coordinator F\-80
* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience working with people diagnosed with mental illness or having addiction or substance use issues.

* Knowledge of case management software

jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys working in an innovative and vibrant workplace? Then TransPerfect is for you!

  

So you like what you hear but haven’t worked in ‘language’ before? That is not a problem, TransPerfect is far from “just a translation agency”. Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalization to multimedia work, video, e\-learning and training, and legal support services. All services and client partnerships are aided by best\-in\-breed software platforms, specialized in optimizing business processes.

  

That’s enough about us – what about you?


We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head if situations get a bit stressful and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

  

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have 90 offices worldwide but this particular opportunity is based in our Atlanta office. We offer career development and an attractive bonus plan and social events are organized frequently.

  

Full details on the role are below:

 **Position Summary:** The position of Associate Project Coordinator is a key player at TransPerfect. Associate Project Coordinators execute all language/translation projects from the start to the finish and serve as a single point of accountability for their successful completion. Individuals in this entry level role are more inclined to stick in a Project Management\-oriented career path (working to become an Executive or Senior Project Manager or a Management\-oriented career (working to become a Team Lead or Department Manager, for instance).

 **Description:**


* Be responsible for the entire life\-cycle of all language/translation projects assigned to the individual
* Juggle multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Understand and abide by individual project instructions
* Liaise with sales staff to clarify project parameters
* Establish and maintain excellent relationships with contract translators and proofreaders globally
* Coordinate with quality personnel to ensure that the translation perfectly complies with instructions and is linguistically perfect
* Communicate any issues/problems/caveats or additional information to sales staff as soon as that information is available
* Research and understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data
* Investigate/resolve client complaints, problem solve, and work with QA/Management to ensure that appropriate systemic changes are implemented
* Perform other special projects or duties when required

 **Required Skills:**


* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Minimum Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience coordinating projects and assignment of resources a plus
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
* Effective time management

**Join Our Team**
-----------------


SFA Partners is a financial services organization that goes beyond traditional broker\-dealer, Registered Investment Advisor, and insurance agency to provide a strategic, open, and professional, business development platform for independent advisors and their clients. Our platform enables our advisors to offer clients a comprehensive planning approach to their entire financial lives – helping clients protect, preserve, accumulate, and transfer wealth.


  
**Position Summary**



The Marketing Coordinator for SFA Partners (The Strategic Financial Alliance and Strategic Blueprint) is responsible for assisting the Director of Marketing with the day\-to\-day tactical implementation of all marketing efforts that affect and support SFA Partners internal departments as well as SFA Partners financial advisors.


**Essential Functions**



Social media and Digital media:


* Assist with sourcing and/or developing content for LinkedIn assets.
* Schedule and post content to LinkedIn.
* Monitor LinkedIn analytics continually and adjust content and frequency of posts
* Manage video library and coordinate production of additional videos as needed


Email:


* Assist with formatting bi\-weekly e\-newsletters and other ad hoc email communications to the SFA Partners Community using HubSpot.
* Collaborate with Director of Marketing and internal departments to collect information for and format department email communications to advisors.


Collateral


* Edit existing brochures and other marketing materials.
* Work with outside designers.


Websites:


* Edit websites (SFA Partners, Strategic Blueprint, and The Strategic Financial Alliance) coordinating with internal departments on changes

* Edit contact database.


Conferences and other events:


* Assist Conference team with marketing logistics and onsite coordination when needed.

**Additional responsibilities based on candidate’s skills:**



* Make basic design edits to digital and print assets


* Coordinate with Human Resources to handle marketing\-related employee onboarding tasks


* Write original blog posts



**Qualifications**



Required:



* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related field of study.


* Experience with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Pilot)


* Experience with online AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude), Adobe Acrobat, Canva


* Experience in WordPress


* Experience with HubSpot or other email marketing, social media, or website platforms.


* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.



Preferred:



* Knowledge of the financial services industry (especially broker dealers and RIA, similar to Charles Schwab, Raymond James, Edward Jones, etc).

**Position Summary**



The Operations Specialist is a primary contact of our operations team, serving as the primary contact for client support inquiries. This role involves managing a wide range of client requests—both written and verbal—and is responsible for problem resolution and service support for advisors and administrative staff processing client transactions through SFA Partners. **Essential Functions**


* Review and process client account information, including account openings.
* Provide general account maintenance and support.
* Review, approve, process, and follow up on incoming funds, disbursement, and asset movement requests.
* Review and process private purchase transactions within brokerage accounts.
* Manage account processing and associated fee billing on the managed account platform.
* Utilize imaging systems and workflows to maintain accurate records.
* Ensure timely completion of tasks and adherence to high service level standards.
* Generate reports to track outstanding and recurring issues, facilitating resolution and prevention.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for all operational processes and procedures, providing support to the team.
* Cross\-train with team members and mentor new employees to enhance team skills and knowledge.
* Carry out additional duties and projects as assigned by management and leadership.
* Collaborate with other departments and external vendors to cultivate strong working relationships.


**Qualifications**


* Minimum of three years of experience in the banking or financial services industry.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and broker\-dealer operations software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in customer service.
* Demonstrated sound judgment and discretion, skilled in conflict resolution.
* Exceptional organizational abilities, time management, multitasking, and priority adjustment skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills, thriving in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Team player with a collaborative mindset and positive attitude.

* Experience in securities and/or broker\-dealer environments.
* Experience with Pershing Netx360\.
* Series 7 license.

By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two\-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

  

PagerDuty is looking for a People Operations Coordinator to join our HR Infrastructure \& Operations team. This role is focused on tactical and administrative excellence, providing foundational support across HR operations, talent acquisition coordination, and global hub management. Working full time out of our Atlanta office, you will ensure the seamless execution of daily workplace experiences and core HR workflows to support our global team.



thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys working cross\-functionally, enjoys a challenge, and is passionate about creating a positive, seamless workplace experience for all.

* **HR Operations:** Partner on onboarding, offboarding, Workday data integrity, and compliance tasks.

* **Local Workplace Experience (Atlanta / Toronto):** Serve as the HR point of contact for local hub operations; own day\-to\-day employee presence and light facilities coordination.


**Basic Qualifications**


* 1–3 years of experience in an HR support, talent acquisition coordination, or workplace operations role.
* Proven track record in handling administrative scheduling, ATS management, and operational logistics.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain data accuracy in HRIS platforms (Workday preferred).
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage on\-site hub logistics and vendor programs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer\-service mindset.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential employee information with high discretion.
* Ability to work on\-site out of our Atlanta office 5 days a week.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in a related field, or equivalent years of experience
* Creative problem\-solving skills
* Strong technical skills with the ability to learn and navigate new systems and processes

* Experience with HRIS systems (Workday or similar)


The base salary range for this position is 60,000 \- 82,000 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.



Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.



Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.



PagerDuty is a flexible, hybrid workplace. We embrace and encourage in\-person working as an integral part of our culture. Both our employees and external research tells us that co\-located collaboration strengthens connections, drives innovation, and accelerates learning.



This role is expected to come into our **Atlanta office 5 days per week**, so you can thrive in your new role and fully embrace being a Dutonian!

Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn't the right role or time \- sign up for job alerts!


**Where we work**



PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we **cannot** employ candidates residing in:

**United States:** Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming

**Sales Coordinator**

**Holiday Inn Express \& Suites Camp Creek**

**Job Type: Full\-Time**

**About the Position**

Holiday Inn Express \& Suites Camp Creek is seeking a motivated, organized, and results\-driven Sales Coordinator to support and grow our hotel's group, meeting, and corporate business.

This is an active **sales position**, not strictly an administrative role. The **Sales Coordinator** will be responsible for responding to group and meeting inquiries, preparing and quoting room and meeting space rates, coordinating events from contract to completion, and actively prospecting for **new business and accounts.**

The ideal candidate is a confident communicator who enjoys building relationships, making sales calls, meeting local businesses, and turning leads into actual hotel business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Group \& Meeting Sales**

* Respond promptly to group room and meeting space inquiries.
* Prepare professional quotes and proposals for group accommodations and meeting space.
* Quote room rates based on hotel availability, demand, group size, dates, and business needs.
* Quote meeting room rental rates and applicable setup fees.
* Discuss event requirements with clients, including dates, number of attendees, room needs, meeting room setup, food and beverage needs, and equipment requirements.
* Follow up consistently on all leads, proposals, and outstanding inquiries.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed group bookings and meetings.
* Prepare group agreements, proposals, contracts, and other sales documentation.
* Obtain deposits and required paperwork in accordance with hotel policies.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, accounts, and confirmed business.

**Meeting \& Event Coordination**

* Coordinate meeting room setups based on client requirements.
* Create and communicate meeting room setup instructions to the appropriate hotel departments.
* Conduct pre\-event walkthroughs with clients when necessary.
* Ensure meeting rooms are properly set up prior to the client's arrival.
* Coordinate with housekeeping, front desk, maintenance, and management to ensure successful events.
* Follow up with clients before, during, and after events to ensure satisfaction.
* Assist with resolving client concerns and ensuring expectations are met.
* Conduct post\-event follow\-up and pursue repeat business.

**New Business Development**

* Actively prospect for new corporate, group, and meeting accounts.
* Make outbound sales calls and conduct sales visits to local businesses and organizations.
* Identify potential accounts in the hotel's market area.
* Develop relationships with local companies, construction companies, hospitals, universities, schools, churches, sports organizations, government agencies, wedding planners, event planners, and other groups.
* Conduct regular sales blitzes and outside sales calls.
* Visit local businesses to introduce the hotel and identify lodging and meeting needs.
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective accounts.
* Follow up with prospects through phone calls, emails, visits, and other appropriate sales methods.
* Identify opportunities for negotiated corporate rates, group room blocks, meetings, reunions, weddings, sports teams, and other group business.
* Maintain relationships with existing accounts while continually pursuing new business.
* Work toward established sales goals and revenue targets.

**Sales Administration**

* Maintain an organized sales filing and tracking system.
* Enter and update sales activities, leads, accounts, and opportunities in the hotel's sales systems.
* Maintain accurate group room block information.
* Communicate group details and special requests to hotel departments.
* Assist with forecasting group room nights and meeting space utilization.
* Monitor upcoming group arrivals and events.
* Assist management with sales reports and revenue information.
* Ensure all contracts and client documentation are complete and properly filed.
* Assist with accounts receivable follow\-up when necessary.

**Customer Service**

* Build strong professional relationships with clients and local businesses.
* Provide prompt, professional, and friendly communication.
* Represent Holiday Inn Express \& Suites Camp Creek positively at all times.
* Anticipate client needs and provide solutions.
* Handle client concerns professionally and escalate issues to management when appropriate.
* Encourage repeat business and referrals.

**Qualifications**

* Previous hotel sales, hospitality, event planning, or business development experience preferred.
* Strong sales and customer service skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Comfortable making outbound sales calls and visiting businesses.
* Confident asking for the business and closing sales.
* Ability to negotiate rates while protecting hotel revenue.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office, email, and basic computer systems.
* Ability to manage multiple leads, groups, and events simultaneously.
* Professional appearance and demeanor.
* Reliable, self\-motivated, and able to work independently.
* Must be comfortable working in a goal\-oriented environment.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **hungry to sell and comfortable being proactive.**

The successful candidate will not wait for business to come to the hotel. You will be expected to **make calls, visit businesses, develop relationships, identify opportunities, follow up on leads, and actively generate new group and corporate business.**

If you enjoy meeting people, building relationships, closing business, and helping a hotel grow, this could be the right opportunity for you.

**Performance Expectations**

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to:

* Generate new leads and accounts.
* Convert inquiries into confirmed group room blocks and meetings.
* Increase group room nights.
* Increase me

jobs.title: Account Manager 2, Merchant Services Managed Money Accounts
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

  

As a Merchant Services Account Manager, you play a vital role in driving growth and protecting revenue for our mid\-market customers. Your primary objective is to deeply engage with customers, gaining a thorough understanding of their business needs across all locations. Leveraging your expertise, you'll demonstrate our core capabilities and recommend the right merchant processing solution stack to meet their specific requirements. Collaborating with internal support partners and resources, you'll ensure seamless execution of our solutions, contributing to Intuit's mission of disrupting the small business mid\-market segment. **Responsibilities**

* Exemplify Intuit's values and foster an inclusive environment conducive to collaboration and innovation.
* Proactively identify opportunities to drive business improvements for existing customers, providing strategic recommendations aligned with their needs.
* Articulate Intuit's value propositions within the merchant services domain, showcasing understanding of our strategies and products relative to competitors.
* Deliver compelling presentations to C\-level executives, effectively communicating ROI and value propositions.
* Grow and manage a robust sales funnel, maintaining a sustainable sales cycle to meet quarterly targets.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders to influence the buying process and navigate complex selling processes.
* Serve as a cross\-functional facilitator, leveraging resources to support business relationship growth and execution.
* Utilize all available resources to efficiently close deals and drive scalability.
* Measure success through key metrics including quota attainment, close rates, pipeline velocity, and retention improvements.

 **Qualifications**

* Minimum 5\+ years of quota\-carrying software or technology sales and corporate account management experience.
* Extensive experience in territory management across multiple states and industries, preferably within the merchant services domain.
* Deep understanding of Account Receivable and Account Payable processes related to money movement.
* Familiarity with merchant services customers owning multiple locations and annual revenues exceeding $5M.
* Familiarity with merchant service industry standards as it relates to rates, cost analysis, and risk management.
* Experience selling merchant services platform solutions with negotiated rates/terms across various industries.
* Strong business acumen and sales skills, with the ability to innovate and iterate.
* Prior experience with accounting, ERP, or financial management software sales.
* Proficiency in managing a large prospect pipeline through Salesforce and supporting multiple partners through the sales process.
* Familiarity with key sales methodologies such as Challenger, SPIN, Solution, or Sandler.
* Understanding of the client management lifecycle and ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree or MBA preferred or equivalent work experience.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

Mountain View, CA $100,000\- $135,000

jobs.description:

**Property Medics of Georgia**  

**Peachtree Corners, GA**  

**Full\-Time**  

**$60,000 Base Salary \+ Performance\-Based Commission \+ Bonus Opportunities**

**About the Role**


Property Medics of Georgia specializes in water, fire, and mold mitigation, contents cleaning, and reconstruction services.


We are growing our Business Development team and looking for a driven, relationship\-focused professional who can help expand our referral network and generate new business opportunities.


This is a field\-based relationship development role. Success comes from building genuine relationships with referral partners, earning trust, generating referrals, and developing those relationships into long\-term producing partnerships.


Previous experience in restoration or a related referral\-driven industry is **strongly preferred, but not required**.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify and develop high\-value referral partners throughout your territory.
* Build relationships with plumbers, insurance professionals, property managers, contractors, and other strategic referral sources.
* Prospect consistently through in\-person visits, phone calls, networking, events, and other relationship\-building activities.
* Turn new contacts into meaningful conversations, first referrals, and long\-term producing relationships.
* Maintain and grow existing referral relationships while identifying opportunities to expand relationships across organizations.
* Represent Property Medics professionally in the community and at industry events.
* Maintain accurate activity, relationship, and opportunity information in the company's CRM.
* Work closely with leadership and operations to ensure referral partners and customers receive an exceptional experience.


Requirements:  



**What We're Looking For**

* Naturally personable with strong conversational and relationship\-building skills.
* Self\-motivated, competitive, persistent, and comfortable working independently in the field.
* Comfortable walking into businesses, starting conversations, and developing relationships from scratch.
* Organized and accountable with strong follow\-up habits.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Coachable, adaptable, and willing to continuously improve.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the assigned territory.
* Previous Business Development, outside sales, account development, or relationship\-based sales experience preferred.
* **Experience in restoration, mitigation, construction, insurance, plumbing, property management, or another referral\-driven industry is strongly preferred, but not required.**
* **An existing network of relevant referral relationships is a significant plus, but not required.**

* **$60,000 annual base salary**
* Performance\-based commission on eligible collected revenue
* Additional commission opportunities for developing new referral partners
* Bonus opportunities based on performance

Property Medics is looking for someone who enjoys being in the field, meeting people, opening doors, and turning relationships into long\-term business opportunities.

jobs.title: Travel Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**We Put the World on Vacation**


Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. **This is a fully virtual work from home sales position for candidates who reside in the states of Florida, Georgia and South Carolina only. Candidates who reside outside of these states will not be considered.** Successful candidates must be able to meet our work at home requirements (see below).

**How You'll Shine:**


Are you passionate about travel and skilled in sales? Join our team as a Travel Sales Representative with Travel \+ Leisure! In this role, you’ll combine your love for customer service with your sales expertise to create unforgettable travel experiences for our clients. Here’s what you’ll do:

**Sales and Customer Service:** Take inbound calls from excited customers ready to plan their dream vacations. Your expertise will guide them through the booking process for car rentals, airfare, hotel reservations, cruises and local experiences.

**Subject Matter Expertise:** As a **Travel Sales Representative,** you’ll be the go\-to resource for our customers. Build rapport and recommend personalized, lifestyle\-aligned travel solutions—air, hotel, cruise, car, and local experiences—curated for each customer.

* **$17\.50 per hour plus monthly sales incentives based off your performance**
* **Start Date: Friday October 16th**

**What You'll Bring:**

* **Proven Sales Experience:** Demonstrated success in driving results through inbound service, outbound follow\-up, and relationship\-based selling.
* **Exceptional Interpersonal Skills:** Quickly establish rapport with customers, engage in meaningful conversations, and create lasting connections. You’ll ask probing questions to understand their travel needs and seamlessly offer additional services.
* **Strong Multitasking Abilities:** Thrive under pressure and handle multiple tasks effectively.
* **Education Requirement:** High School Diploma or GED is required.
* **Customer Service and Sales Experience:** Six months of experience in both areas.
* **Travel Experience Preferred:** Six months of travel\-related experience is a plus.
* **Technology Agility:** Comfortable managing several technology applications simultaneously (CRM, booking tools, payment systems, communication apps). Prior travel software knowledge (e.g., Amadeus, Apollo, Sabre, Worldspan) is helpful but not required; ability to learn quickly is essential.
* **Training Schedule:** A 5\-week training schedule from 11:00 am to 8:00 pm EST.
* **Post\-Training Availability:** Be available to work between 8:00 am and 10:00 pm EST Monday to Saturday with a set schedule provided.
* **Holiday Availability:** Ability to work some holidays.

**What is required for me to work from home?**

* Quiet workplace free of distractions and background noise
* High speed internet requirements Download speed of 20 mbps and upload speed of 3 mbps average ping below 100m
* Must be able to hardwire computer directly to a router
* Must have own personal device with a working camera to be used for the first week of training (until our computers reach your home)
* Intermediate computer proficiency and ability to troubleshoot technical issues while at home

**So what are you waiting for? Apply today to start your next career journey with Travel \& Leisure—where you’ll deliver not just trips, but unforgettable, concierge\-level experiences for every customer!**

 **How You'll Be Rewarded:**


We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include:


***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.***

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life and accident coverage
* Disability
* Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
* 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Legal and identify theft plan
* Voluntary income protection benefits
* Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
* Employee Assistance Program

 **Where Memories Start with You**


Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Parts Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**About Us**

GrinderCrusherScreen has been in the heavy equipment business since 1973\. We sell, broker, and support grinders, crushers, screening plants, and the wear parts that keep them running. Our customers are land clearing crews, recycling yards, compost operations, and contractors across the country. When their machine is down, they call us.

We are small, fast moving, and we promote from the inside.

**The Role**

This is an entry level seat in our parts department. You do not need equipment experience. You need to be reliable, comfortable on the phone, and willing to learn a real trade.

You will spend your day talking to customers. Some of them call us. Most of them we call. Your job is to keep our existing customers buying and to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**What You'll Do**

* Make outbound calls to past customers to check on their equipment, their wear parts usage, and their upcoming needs
* Answer inbound calls, help where you can, and route the rest to the right person quickly
* Quote parts orders (screens, wear tips, and related components) using our pricing guidelines
* Enter and maintain customer records, quotes, and follow ups in our CRM
* Follow up on open quotes until you get a yes or a no
* Coordinate with our parts and technical team on lead times, shipping, and order status
* Learn the equipment: what a grinder is, what a screen does, and why the right part matters

**What We're Looking For**

* Dependable and on time, every day
* Clear, confident phone communication and comfort making outbound calls
* Basic computer skills and a willingness to learn our CRM (we will train you)
* Organized enough to track your own follow ups without being reminded
* Coachable, curious, and interested in learning an industry from the ground up
* High school diploma or equivalent

**Nice to have, not required:**

* Conversational Spanish
* Prior phone, retail, counter sales, or customer service experience
* Any exposure to parts, equipment, automotive, or construction

**What You'll Get**

* $22\.00 to $25\.00 per hour, based on experience
* Part time or full time, we will build the schedule around the right person
* Hands on training in parts, pricing, and equipment
* A clear path into a sales career in an industry most people never hear about
* A team small enough that your work is visible

**To Apply**

Apply through this posting with your resume. If you do not have a resume, send us a short note about where you have worked and why this interests you. We read everything.

GrinderCrusherScreen is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

This role is the front door of our sales motion: you’ll open conversations with district HR leaders and their teams, build genuine relationships across district offices, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. Your credibility as someone who has been in the building and understands what it means when a classroom or cafeteria is short\-staffed is what will set you apart.

* Conduct high\-volume, high\-quality outbound calling to K\-12 district HR contacts within assigned territories, supplemented by short, purposeful follow\-up emails

* Develop authentic relationships with everyone you reach, including front\-office staff and administrative gatekeepers, treating every conversation as an opportunity to learn about the district’s staffing needs
* Translate what you hear into concise, personalized follow\-up that reflects each district’s specific needs
* Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and own the handoff, including confirmation and reminder touchpoints that drive meeting attendance, not just meeting acceptance
* Track activity, conversations, and pipeline contributions accurately in our CRM

Required

* Strong self\-direction: you can take a territory or target list and independently figure out who to call and why
* Clear, simple, communication style, with the discipline to keep messages short and relevant

ABOUT THE ROLE Join a fast\-growing fire and life\-safety organization as a Sales Representative serving the Las Vegas market. This is a full\-time, onsite sales role for someone who knows how to build new relationships, grow existing accounts, and manage the sales process from first conversation through signed contract and Notice to Proceed.



You will sell comprehensive fire protection and life\-safety solutions across construction and service opportunities, including design, installation, testing, inspection, maintenance, suppression, detection, and security\-related offerings. The right person is comfortable with both inside and outside sales work, can read the needs behind a bid invite or customer request, and can turn technical service capabilities into clear, practical proposals.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



* Develop new business and expand existing customer accounts across the Las Vegas market
* Sell fire protection, life\-safety, construction, and service solutions to commercial customers
* Manage the full sales cycle from lead generation, qualification, and bid invitations through proposals, contracts, and Notice to Proceed
* Build strong relationships with general contractors, facility leaders, property managers, and other decision makers
* Review customer needs, project requirements, site conditions, and bid documents to shape accurate sales opportunities
* Coordinate with operations, estimating, design, inspection, service, and project teams to deliver responsive proposals
* Maintain a disciplined pipeline, follow\-up rhythm, and accurate sales activity records
* Support both new account development and ongoing account management
* Travel locally and regionally as needed, up to approximately 40%
* Represent the company professionally while following safety, compliance, and customer\-site requirements

WHAT YOU BRING



* Experience selling fire protection, life\-safety, construction, service, inspection, suppression, detection, security, or related building\-services solutions
* Strong business development ability across both new logos and existing accounts
* Comfort owning a sales process that includes lead generation, bid review, proposal coordination, negotiation, contract follow\-through, and handoff to operations
* Ability to communicate clearly with customers, internal technical teams, contractors, and field leaders
* Practical understanding of construction/service sales, customer urgency, bid timelines, and recurring account development
* Strong organization, follow\-up discipline, and CRM or pipeline\-management habits
* Valid driver's license, acceptable driving record, reliable transportation, and ability to travel as needed
* Ability to pass required employment screening, including drug\-free workplace and E\-Verify requirements
* Ability to work onsite in Las Vegas, NV and visit customer or project locations as needed

COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS



* Full\-time employee role
* Salary range: $75,000\-$85,000
* Competitive pay and bonus opportunities
* Paid vacation and holidays
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* FSA options
* Employer\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability
* Life insurance, voluntary ancillary benefits, EAP, and employee referral program
* Training, advancement, certification reimbursement, and potential certification bonuses

LOCATION \& WORK ENVIRONMENT This is an onsite role based in Las Vegas, NV. The position includes customer meetings, jobsite visits, office work, and local or regional travel up to approximately 40%. Work may involve active construction or service environments where PPE and site safety requirements apply.

jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better\-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.


We manage the medical imaging pathway end\-to\-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.


We're looking for a **Recruiting Coordinator** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.


Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------


As a **Recruiting Coordinator**, you'll support the candidate and new\-hire experience from the moment a requisition opens to an employee's first day on the job. This is a remote role at the heart of how we bring new people into Scan.com. You'll be the connective tissue between hiring managers, candidates, and new starters, making sure nothing falls through the cracks as we keep growing fast.


As a scale\-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

* Support the end\-to\-end talent coordination process, from requisition opening through to an employee's Day One
* Maintain and optimize Ashby, our applicant tracking system, so it works smoothly for hiring managers and candidates alike
* Schedule interviews across time zones, keeping the experience seamless for candidates and interviewers
* Coordinate internal interview loops and debriefs, keeping panels aligned and on schedule
* Generate offer documentation and start details for incoming employees
* Coordinate IT setup for new hires, making sure equipment and access are ready before Day One
* Manage pre\-onboarding communications so new hires feel informed and welcomed before they arrive
* Support onboarding operations through an employee's first day
* Help manage occasional requisitions, with the opportunity to build broader talent/recruitment experience over time

**THE TOP 5 THINGS WE WANT YOU TO ACHIEVE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR ARE**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* Every candidate who moves through our process has a smooth, well\-organized, and professional experience, from first interview to offer
* Ashby is running as a clean, reliable system of record, giving hiring managers and the Talent team accurate visibility into every open requisition
* New hires consistently arrive on Day One with their equipment, access, and onboarding plan fully in place, with zero last\-minute scrambles
* You've built trusted working relationships with hiring managers across the business, becoming the go\-to person for a smooth hiring process
* You've made our hiring experience more efficient by building in automations throughout the process without sacrificing quality or introducing bias

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------


You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple moving parts (interviews, offers, onboarding tasks) at once
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with candidates, hiring managers, and new hires
* Experience with an ATS (we use Ashby), calendar scheduling tools, and HR systems
* A drive to collaborate with your team on building a fair, consistent, and welcoming experience for every candidate who comes through our process
* A genuine interest in growing a career in talent/recruitment, with an eagerness to take on more responsibility over time
* Comfort working independently in a remote environment while staying closely coordinated with your team
* Experience using AI and/or automation tools to improve processes, distinguishing between the activities that need to have a human in the loop and the processes where technology can save time
* Experience integrating with ChartHop is a plus

**AI REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------


At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done because of it.

* Tier 2 — For this role, the expectation is that you are AI\-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data. (most commercial, marketing, finance, people, and G\&A roles)


	+ AI is part of your daily default. You use it to draft, analyze, research, and pressure\-test your own thinking.
	+ You can show concrete examples where AI made your work meaningfully faster or better.
	+ You know its failure modes: you check its work, and you don't paste sensitive data into public tools.
	+ **Assessment:** We'll ask you to walk through how you'd use AI to tackle a real task from the role.

*One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.*

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

The Revenue Operations Analyst will join Epsilon's Revenue Operations team in a foundational support role designed to strengthen day\-to\-day operational support for sales leaders and business partners. This role will help own operational and execution\-oriented responsibilities related to revenue operations, creating clearer focus across the team and enabling business unit partners and functional RevOps leads to stay aligned to their core areas of ownership across business partnership, process design, governance, analytics, and systems implementation.  

  

This is a strong opportunity for someone who is detail\-oriented, organized, comfortable working with data, and interested in building depth in how revenue operations supports sales execution across a complex business. The role will provide hands\-on exposure to CRM data quality, sales process and systems administration, reporting support, intake tracking, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

Sales Leader and Business Partner Support
  

* Provide operational and coordination support to sales leaders and RevOps business unit partners across recurring sales operations activities.
* Help track, organize, and follow up on sales support requests, intake items, and open operational tasks.
* Prepare and maintain recurring materials, trackers, summaries, and status updates used by sales leadership and RevOps stakeholders.

  

CRM, Data Quality, and Process Administration
  

* Assist with CRM data hygiene activities, including identifying missing, outdated, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
* Support maintenance of account, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data according to established RevOps standards.
* Help ensure sales teams are following defined processes, required fields, naming conventions, and data entry expectations.

  

Reporting and Analytics Support
  

* Support recurring sales and pipeline reporting by gathering inputs, validating data, refreshing standard reports, and preparing summaries for review.
* Assist with basic analysis of sales operations data, including pipeline movement, activity tracking, data completeness, and process adherence.
* Partner with Revenue Intelligence and business partners to clarify reporting requests and ensure needed inputs are captured accurately.
* Help document reporting definitions, field usage, and business rules to support consistency across revenue reporting.

  

Documentation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement
  

* Create and maintain documentation for repeatable sales operations processes, support workflows, and RevOps operating procedures.
* Support training and enablement efforts by helping prepare job aids, process guides, checklists, and simple how\-to materials.

  

What Success Looks Like
  

* Sales leaders and business partners receive timely, accurate support on recurring operational needs.
* Operational work is organized, tracked, and completed consistently.
* CRM and sales operations data is complete, accurate, and aligned to established standards.
* Recurring reports, trackers, and process documentation are maintained with strong attention to detail.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, marketing, or a related field.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring tasks accurately and consistently.
* Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and structured processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM and reporting tools quickly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize information clearly.
* Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment.
* Interest in revenue operations, sales operations, business process improvement, or go\-to\-market operations.

  

Preferred  

* Relevant experience through internships, coursework, project work, or prior roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, analytics, finance, or marketing operations.
* Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Experience building or maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, process documentation, or project status updates.
* Familiarity with sales pipeline, forecasting, account management, lead/opportunity workflows, or commercial operations concepts.

  

Ideal Candidate  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who is eager to learn, takes pride in accuracy, and is motivated by improving process, organization, and operational consistency. They are comfortable with operational detail, able to follow and improve repeatable processes, and interested in growing within revenue operations over time. This person should be service\-oriented, dependable, and willing to lean into the details that help sales leaders and business partners work more effectively.  

  

This role can serve as a foundation for growth into the Revenue Operations function. As the analyst builds experience, they may take on more advanced ownership of reporting, process improvement, CRM administration, project coordination, or business unit partnership support.  

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.
  

  

**Additional Information**  

**When you join Epsilon, we'll create something EPIC together.** We're a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30\+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Sales Consultant
jobs.description:
**Full Time** position in 1 North Wacker Drive Chicago, IL, 60602  

  



**Job Title: Digital Marketing Sales Consultant**
  

*Location: Chicago, IL\-Hybrid/Remote*  

  

  



**If you've ever sold digital marketing to a small business owner and actually enjoyed it — this is the role you've been waiting for.**


**About Us:**


Predictive Sales AI builds AI\-powered websites and digital marketing tools specifically for home services contractors — HVAC companies, plumbers, roofers, landscapers. We help them show up online, generate more leads, and grow their business. Our clients are owner\-operators who work hard and need a marketing partner they can trust. That's where you come in.


**The Role:**


As a **Digital Marketing Sales Consultant** you'll be selling PSAI's websites, SEO, PPC, and Google Ads services to home services business owners across South Florida and beyond. This is a consultative sale — you're not order\-taking, you're helping contractors understand why their current marketing isn't working and showing them a better path.


You'll manage your own pipeline, run discovery calls, present proposals, and close deals. The sales cycle is typically 2–4 weeks. Most of your buyers are skeptical at first — they've been burned by marketing agencies before. Your job is to earn their trust fast and back it up with results.


**What You'll Do:**


* Prospect and develop your own pipeline through outreach, referrals, and warm leads from our marketing team
* Run discovery calls to understand a contractor's current marketing, pain points, and growth goals
* Present PSAI's digital marketing solutions — websites, SEO, PPC, Google Ads — and tailor proposals to each client's situation
* Handle objections from skeptical business owners who have been burned by agencies before
* Close deals and hand off to the client success team for onboarding
* Hit monthly revenue targets and maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM
* Stay current on digital marketing trends so you can speak credibly to clients about what actually works


**What We're Looking For:**


**Required:**


* 1–5 years of sales experience — digital marketing, SaaS, lead gen, or related field
* Comfortable selling to small business owners — you understand how they think and what they care about
* Strong phone and video presence — most of your outreach and demos will be remote
* Self\-starter who can manage their own pipeline without being micromanaged
* Genuine interest in digital marketing — you don't need to be a technical expert but you need to care about the product
* Based in or commutable to Boca Raton, FL for hybrid work schedule


**Bonus Points:**


* Experience selling to home services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping)
* Background selling SEO, PPC, Google Ads, or website services
* Sold for a digital agency, lead gen platform (Angi, HomeAdvisor), or local marketing company
* Familiar with contractor objections — ROI conversations, skepticism of digital marketing, long decision cycles


**Who Success Here:**


The reps who thrive at PSAI are hunters. They're comfortable picking up the phone, handling a tough objection, and following up until they get a yes or a no. They're also genuine — contractor owners can smell a pitch from a mile away, and the best reps here build trust quickly by being real.


* You're a closer — you know how to create urgency without being pushy
* You're resilient — rejection doesn't derail you, it refocuses you
* You're curious — you ask good questions and actually listen to the answers
* You're coachable — you want feedback and use it to get better
* You're hungry — you're motivated by commission and want to control your own earnings


**Why PSAI?**


* **You're selling something that works.** Our clients see real results — more calls, more leads, more booked jobs. That makes every sales conversation easier.
* **The market is massive.** There are hundreds of thousands of home services contractors in the US and most of them have terrible marketing. The opportunity is enormous.
* **You control your earnings.** Competitive base plus uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make.
* **You're hybrid.** Work from home most of the time with regular check\-ins at our Boca Raton office. No five\-day commute.
* **You'll grow.** We're a growing company — reps who perform get more responsibility, better accounts, and a real career path.


**Sound like you?**


Apply with your resume and tell us in 2–3 sentences about the toughest SMB sale you've ever closed — what made it hard and how you got it done. That's all we need to get started.

**Territory Collaboration \& Execution*** Work collaboratively within assigned regions alongside existing sales team members to maximize coverage and opportunity capture.

* Share market intelligence, competitive insights, and prospecting feedback with the broader sales organization.

**Technical \& Market Understanding*** Established background with demonstrated working knowledge of automated liquid handling robotics, including applications and workflows.
* Understand and communicate key applications such as PCR, NGS, and sample preparation workflows.
* Effectively position Hamilton solutions to new prospects based on their scientific and operational needs.
* Provide feedback from the field to product and marketing teams to support continuous improvement and market alignment.

* Strong hunter mentality with demonstrated success in prospecting and new business development.
* Ability to engage and build relationships with scientists, lab managers, and procurement stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including ability to articulate value to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

Education/Experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or related field.
* Minimum of 3 \+ years of sales or business development experience in life sciences, capital equipment, or laboratory instrumentation.
* **Must have experience with Automated Liquid Handling Equipment.**
* Demonstrated success in lead generation, prospecting, and pipeline development.
* Experience with automated liquid handling or laboratory automation is strongly preferred.

new_jobs.description:
**About National Permit Group**

National Permit Group is a full\-service permit and planning firm based in West Hollywood, CA, helping residential and commercial clients get their projects approved and permitted — primarily throughout Southern California, with additional projects in other states. We work with homeowners, developers, contractors, and property owners — and because we have an in\-house design team preparing architectural plans, we're able to offer clients a complete path from design through permit issuance.

Getting a project approved isn't just paperwork — it's a relationship business. Plans sit with city reviewers, questions come back, engineers need to weigh in, clients want to know what's actually happening. We're looking for someone who can own that relationship on all sides: the client who wants answers, and the city officials, plan checkers, and engineers who have them.

**About the Role**

We're hiring an **Account Manager / Permit Coordinator** to serve as the primary point of contact between our clients and everyone involved in getting their project permitted — city planning and building departments, plan checkers, permit techs, structural engineers, and contractors. This is not a data\-entry or paperwork\-routing role. It's a relationship and advocacy role: you're the person who knows the status of every project, knows who to call when something stalls, and knows how to ask the right question to get it moving.

What You'll Do

**Client Relationship Management**

* Serve as the main point of contact for residential homeowners and corporate clients (retail, restaurant, hospitality) throughout their project's permitting process
* Proactively communicate project status to clients with specifics — current stage, what's driving any delay, and the next concrete step — rather than a generic "still pending"
* Send plans to clients for review and approval, and manage their feedback
* Respond to client emails and calls promptly and knowledgeably

**City \& Agency Coordination**

* Communicate directly with city and county building/planning departments, plan checkers, permit techs, and officials
* Push each project forward by asking the right questions of reviewers and officials — identifying who's responsible, what's causing a delay, and when escalation is warranted — rather than passively waiting on a response
* Make submittals and pick up/drop off plans at city building and planning departments as needed
* Upload and download plans and corrections through city and agency portals
* Manage the issuance of permits once approvals are complete

**Project Coordination**

* Track every project's status in Trello, including when corrections come back and when plans are sent to the structural engineer
* Coordinate with our in\-house design team, structural engineers, and outside contractors to keep projects moving
* Flag risks or delays before they become client\-facing problems

**Administrative Support (light)**

* Keep project files and portal access organized
* Occasional coordination of ownership calendar/meetings related to client projects

**What We're Looking For**

*Required*

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a client\-facing coordination role — account management, client services, project coordination, or similar — ideally in construction, architecture, real estate development, or a related field
* Comfort being persistent and assertive with government offices and third parties on a client's behalf
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical/process status in plain language to clients
* Highly organized and able to track multiple projects at different stages simultaneously
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (occasional travel to city offices and project sites)

*Preferred*

* Experience with permit processing, plan checking, or municipal approval processes
* Familiarity with Trello or similar project\-tracking tools
* Background or coursework in architecture, urban planning, or construction management
* Existing relationships with Southern California city planning/building departments

**What Makes You Successful**

* You take ownership of a project rather than waiting to be told what's next
* You're comfortable pushing back and escalating — professionally — when something isn't moving
* You can hold a lot of moving pieces in your head (or your Trello board) without dropping them
* You're as comfortable talking to a homeowner as you are to a plan checker
* You like being the person who actually knows what's going on

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews.


Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

  

The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity.

  

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.


The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.


We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own adoption, retention, and growth across a mature portfolio of 100–200\+ accounts in our Scaled segment — and you'll build the systems that make covering a book that size possible.


You'll determine the right signals, automate analysis and follow\-ups, and design an operating model that gives customers an excellent experience. Roughly 70% of your time will be portfolio management; the other 30% will be building the infrastructure and process behind it — working closely with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.


This is a foundational hire. The health scoring, playbooks, and operating cadences you build will be the ones the team runs on for years, and you'll help define what "Scaled" means at Outset as the segment grows.

**Responsibilities**

* Own adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across a portfolio of 100–200\+ Scaled accounts, from onboarding through renewal
* Keep usage and adoption high in a deliberately lower\-touch model — leverage programs, automation, and self\-service before reaching for a calendar invite
* Monitor account health and usage signals to catch risk and expansion opportunities early, and prioritize where your direct time actually changes the outcome
* Run renewals across a mixed model of actively managed and auto\-renewing accounts, partnering with our broader CS team on commercial approach
* Build and run one\-to\-many programs: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in\-product guidance, documentation, and templated success plans
* Develop our account health tracking methodology from the ground up — what signals matter, how they're weighted, how they trigger action, and how we know the scoring is predictive
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering to build the infrastructure behind scaled CS: usage instrumentation, alerting, lifecycle triggers, and automated follow\-up
* Design the operational cadence for this segment: what regular communication looks like, how issues route to and from Product Support, and what escalation looks like. (Product Support owns ticket resolution. You own the process around it).
* Build reporting in Hex and with other AI tools that gives the business real visibility into Scaled segment health, adoption, and retention
* Translate portfolio\-wide patterns into prioritized input for Product

**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years in customer success, account management, CS operations, sales, or lifecycle/growth, including a high\-volume portfolio
* Experience building scaled or digital CS programs from scratch, or working as one of the first hires in a scaled CS role
* Technically fluent and self\-sufficient with data: product analytics and usage, pulling data with AI tools, and building tooling with AI
* Hands\-on with a modern GTM and support stack. Ours is Pylon, Hex, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Claude; we lean heavily on AI day to day and expect you to as well
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Series A/B/C or fast\-paced SaaS experience, with a proactive, ownership\-driven approach to ambiguity

**Nice to have**

* Experience defining or re\-segmenting a customer base, or standing up a support model for a new segment
* Background in customer marketing, growth, or RevOps
* Familiarity with research operations or market research


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K
