new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

The Revenue Operations Analyst will join Epsilon's Revenue Operations team in a foundational support role designed to strengthen day\-to\-day operational support for sales leaders and business partners. This role will help own operational and execution\-oriented responsibilities related to revenue operations, creating clearer focus across the team and enabling business unit partners and functional RevOps leads to stay aligned to their core areas of ownership across business partnership, process design, governance, analytics, and systems implementation.  

  

This is a strong opportunity for someone who is detail\-oriented, organized, comfortable working with data, and interested in building depth in how revenue operations supports sales execution across a complex business. The role will provide hands\-on exposure to CRM data quality, sales process and systems administration, reporting support, intake tracking, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

Sales Leader and Business Partner Support
  

* Provide operational and coordination support to sales leaders and RevOps business unit partners across recurring sales operations activities.
* Help track, organize, and follow up on sales support requests, intake items, and open operational tasks.
* Prepare and maintain recurring materials, trackers, summaries, and status updates used by sales leadership and RevOps stakeholders.

  

CRM, Data Quality, and Process Administration
  

* Assist with CRM data hygiene activities, including identifying missing, outdated, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
* Support maintenance of account, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data according to established RevOps standards.
* Help ensure sales teams are following defined processes, required fields, naming conventions, and data entry expectations.

  

Reporting and Analytics Support
  

* Support recurring sales and pipeline reporting by gathering inputs, validating data, refreshing standard reports, and preparing summaries for review.
* Assist with basic analysis of sales operations data, including pipeline movement, activity tracking, data completeness, and process adherence.
* Partner with Revenue Intelligence and business partners to clarify reporting requests and ensure needed inputs are captured accurately.
* Help document reporting definitions, field usage, and business rules to support consistency across revenue reporting.

  

Documentation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement
  

* Create and maintain documentation for repeatable sales operations processes, support workflows, and RevOps operating procedures.
* Support training and enablement efforts by helping prepare job aids, process guides, checklists, and simple how\-to materials.

  

What Success Looks Like
  

* Sales leaders and business partners receive timely, accurate support on recurring operational needs.
* Operational work is organized, tracked, and completed consistently.
* CRM and sales operations data is complete, accurate, and aligned to established standards.
* Recurring reports, trackers, and process documentation are maintained with strong attention to detail.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, marketing, or a related field.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring tasks accurately and consistently.
* Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and structured processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM and reporting tools quickly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize information clearly.
* Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment.
* Interest in revenue operations, sales operations, business process improvement, or go\-to\-market operations.

  

Preferred  

* Relevant experience through internships, coursework, project work, or prior roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, analytics, finance, or marketing operations.
* Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Experience building or maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, process documentation, or project status updates.
* Familiarity with sales pipeline, forecasting, account management, lead/opportunity workflows, or commercial operations concepts.

  

Ideal Candidate  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who is eager to learn, takes pride in accuracy, and is motivated by improving process, organization, and operational consistency. They are comfortable with operational detail, able to follow and improve repeatable processes, and interested in growing within revenue operations over time. This person should be service\-oriented, dependable, and willing to lean into the details that help sales leaders and business partners work more effectively.  

  

This role can serve as a foundation for growth into the Revenue Operations function. As the analyst builds experience, they may take on more advanced ownership of reporting, process improvement, CRM administration, project coordination, or business unit partnership support.  

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.
  

  

**Additional Information**  

**When you join Epsilon, we'll create something EPIC together.** We're a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30\+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
We believe in the life\-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.


So if you love sports and their community\-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote\-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

**About the Role**


GameChanger is the \#1 youth sports app for live streaming, scorekeeping, and team management. We power millions of games each year, connecting athletes, families, and communities through technology. As we expand across sports—including continued growth in baseball and softball and rapid investment in basketball—we’re building a sales function to accelerate our next phase of growth.


We’re looking for our first Account Manager to join our growing sales organization. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales, you’ll own the customer journey after the initial sale—from a seamless handoff and onboarding through adoption, expansion, and renewal. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to Club Directors and other organization leaders, helping them successfully launch GameChanger across their teams and build lasting value over time.


This is a unique opportunity to help define and scale GameChanger’s account management motion. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Product, and other teams to turn new partnerships into healthy, growing customer relationships while bringing the voice of the customer back into the business.


You’ll focus on two key growth areas:

* **Basketball (B2B2C):** Guiding clubs and organizations from onboarding through sustained adoption across teams, athletes, and families
* **Diamond Sports (B2B):** Retaining and expanding relationships with leagues, tournaments, and organizations in baseball and softball


If you’re energized by building trusted partnerships, thrive in a high\-ownership environment, and enjoy turning customer outcomes into durable business growth, we’d love to meet you.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Post\-Sale Transition \& Onboarding**

* Own the customer relationship from the moment a new agreement is signed, partnering with the Account Executive on a clear handoff.
* Lead onboarding with Club Directors and organization leaders, including account configuration, team setup, stakeholder alignment, and launch planning.
* Create clear success plans, milestones, and responsibilities that help each organization move quickly from signed agreement to active use.
* Equip Club Directors and coaches with the guidance, resources, and communication plans they need to introduce GameChanger to teams and families.

**Drive Adoption \& Account Growth**

* Build trusted, ongoing relationships with Club Directors, league administrators, coaches, and other key stakeholders through regular, proactive check\-ins.
* Monitor customer health and adoption signals—including team setup, coach activation, parent participation, athlete claims, and fan engagement—to identify progress, gaps, and opportunities.
* Develop and execute account plans that increase product adoption, deepen engagement, and expand GameChanger across additional teams, programs, or sports.
* Coordinate targeted education, enablement, and lifecycle communications with Customer Experience and Marketing to help customers achieve their goals.

**Own Retention \& Renewals**

* Own the renewal process for your portfolio, from early planning and value reinforcement through agreement execution.
* Identify risk early, build recovery plans, and mobilize the right internal partners to protect customer outcomes and retention.
* Maintain accurate account health, renewal forecasting, growth opportunities, and customer activity in the CRM.
* Consistently achieve retention, renewal, adoption, and expansion goals.

**Build \& Improve the Account Management Motion**

* Help establish repeatable onboarding, account planning, adoption, expansion, referral and renewal playbooks as the function grows.
* Share customer insights and patterns with Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Product to improve the end\-to\-end customer journey and inform roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Sales leadership to define success metrics, operating rhythms, and scalable processes for account management.

**Who You Are**

* 3–5\+ years of B2B or B2B2C account management, customer success, or post\-sales experience, ideally with responsibility for renewals and expansion.
* Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding retention, renewal, adoption, or growth goals.
* Experience onboarding and managing multi\-stakeholder accounts, from senior decision\-makers to day\-to\-day users.
* Strong consultative, relationship\-building, and executive communication skills, with the ability to connect customer goals to measurable outcomes.
* Comfort using customer data and account health signals to prioritize action and manage a portfolio proactively.
* Experience using CRM and customer success platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar tools.
* Self\-starter who enjoys working in an early\-stage, fast\-paced environment with significant ownership.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the diamond (baseball/softball) and basketball sports markets.
* Prior experience working within the club sports ecosystem is highly preferred.
* Ability to travel on an as\-needed basis.

**Why Join GameChanger**

* Opportunity to help shape the future of the sales organization at a category\-leading product
* Direct impact on growth a

new_jobs.title: Content and Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
Description:

 The Content \& Social Media Manager is responsible for owning Milk Bar’s content machine, building best in class content and community building strategies for Milk Bar’s brand channels. In this role, you will drive Milk Bar’s owned digital content and community strategy, ensuring channel connectivity throughout brand campaigns, messaging, product launches, and more.


You enthusiastically create thumb\-stopping content and engage Milk Bar’s community both on and offline, overseeing and executing interactive content ideation, planning, production, and daily publishing. You are creative and trend\-savvy with a deep understanding of how to thoughtfully connect a brand’s ethos to its customers through social content and communication, in service of brand and business goals.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own Milk Bar’s and Christina Tosi’s content and community strategy, driving strategy, monthly planning, concepting, creative execution and publishing for their social and content ecosystem in support of brand and business objectives
* Lead all social media content production, finely balancing both scrappy, self\-produced content and Creative\-team produced content, with the goal of creating compelling and engaging content to activate Milk Bar’s community. Brief Creative team on an as\-needed basis on specific content needs.
* Lead strategic influencer relations, including relationship nurturing, product comping and providing channel teams strategic recommendations of influencers to leverage (budget depending)
* Serve as an extension of the culinary and R\&D teams, visiting Milk Bar bakeries and R\&D Kitchen (located in Williamsburg) multiple times per week to capture in\-the\-moment happenings; drive Milk Bar’s culinary RTBs in over 50% of content. Partner with Creative team on development of large brand shoot ideas, copy, and visuals tied to launches and marquee brand moments to ensure a strong and unified brand message and experience across all channels
* Respond to daily mentions across platforms; partner with internal Communications and Customer Experience team to maintain brand representation across all social media platforms. Provide a best in class customer experience by providing clear and easy resolutions in a timely and positive manner.
* Leverage social media software and additional industry resources to glean insights to optimize content strategy, drive best\-in\-class engagement, and understand digital trends.
* Function as internal digital trend lead for Brand team, proactively identifying opportunities for real\-time content and engagement in the digital space, and sharing digital \& cultural trends on ongoing basis with team
* Fully understand and exhibit the Milk Bar ethos, embody our core values, inspire celebration and create real magic. Serve as a brand ambassador, both internally and externally.

**Please note that your duties are subject to change at the Company’s discretion.**


Requirements:  

* Bachelor’s degree with focus on business, marketing, communications preferred
* 2\+ years professional experience in a creative or marketing\-focused role
* Working knowledge of and proficiency in iPhone photography, video editing, and Adobe design programs
* Background in the food and beverage or hospitality industry is a plus!
* Experience working in a fast paced, high\-growth startup environment; must be comfortable navigating multiple priorities and building plans from scratch.
* Creative thinker, never satisfied with the status quo and always trying to bring the brand to new levels
* Excellent project and process management and organizational skills, with outstanding attention to detail.
* Collaboration and cross\-functional teamwork: you love working with others and are great at building relationships inside and outside of your department.
* Proactivity and curiosity: you ask questions and challenge the norm.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**City:** New York  

**Department:** Business Development


**Recruiter:** Marcus Gipson

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.



We're looking for a motivated and driven **Business Development Representative** who will be responsible for leading, managing and strengthening relationships with our bus operator partners, ensuring long\-term success, and identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion. The Business Development Representative will also be responsible for sourcing new partners to work with Flix.



This role demands a strategic thinker with a proven track record in business development, adept at navigating complex negotiations and fostering long\-term relationships.


**About the Role**


* Manage and nurture relationships with existing partners, ensuring mutual growth and profitability
* Identify and secure new partnerships with intercity bus operators and other relevant stakeholders to expand Flix's presence in the US East region
* Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes, informing strategic decisions
* Work closely with internal teams, including Network Planning, Operations, Finance, and Marketing, to ensure cohesive strategy execution
* Develop processes and coordinate a variety of projects, making sure the interactions between departments are fluid and results are delivered in a timely manner
* Analyze and optimize partner performance using data\-driven insights, collaborating with internal teams to adjust network strategy and maximize profitability
* Serve as a Flix ambassador at industry events, conferences, and meetings, enhancing brand visibility and credibility


**About You**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Communications or a related field
* 3\-5 years of experience in an externally facing role (business development, sales, account management, consulting or strategic roles)
* Full of ambition, not afraid of rapid change, and able to deal with ambiguity
* Strong analytical abilities, strong negotiation skills, excellent communication skills, proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making and capable of building strong relationships with various types of companies and stakeholders
* Entrepreneurial mindset, self\-motivated, and capable of working autonomously to achieve ambitious targets
* Willingness to travel, up to 20% of time


*Salary Range: $85,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00* *USD*



We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Comprehensive Wellness Coverage**\- Competitive Medical, Vision, and Dental plans, including multiple FSAs (Health and Dependent Care).
* **401(k) Matching**– 401(k) plan with up to 4% company matching contributions.
* **Flexible Time Off**\- Take time off when you need it, as you need it, subject to business needs and manager approval.
* **Paid Parental Leave**\- 8 weeks of fully paid leave to support new parents and growing families.
* **Company Paid Life Insurance**– Basic company\-paid life insurance equal to your annual salary.
* **Lifestyle Spending Account** – Receive up to $600 per year for eligible lifestyle\-related services.
* **Tuition Support**\- Up to $5,250 per year reimbursed for your continued education and development after 12 months of continuous service.
* **24/7 Employee Assistance Program**\- Free, confidential support for mental health, legal, financial, and family issues, including up to 5 free counseling sessions per year.
* **Free Travel Perks**– Complimentary travel on FlixBus and Greyhound for you, family, and friends.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere** \- Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location,



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.



If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Enterprise Technology Services \[ETS] Finance is a strategic partner to ETS, responsible for enabling innovation, driving growth, and delivering on the company's commitment to provide the world's best customer experience every day. ETS designs, builds, and operates the technology platforms, digital products, and infrastructure that support secure, reliable, and scalable experiences for customers and colleagues.


Our team is seeking a full\-time Executive Assistant to support the ETS Finance leadership team, including the Vice President \& CFO. Based in New York City, this hybrid role offers the opportunity to work both virtually and on\-site at the Amex Tower. The Executive Assistant will provide proactive executive and operational support in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment while helping leaders stay focused on strategic priorities and business objectives.


We are looking for a high\-performing, energetic colleague with a positive attitude and ability to think critically, organize flawlessly and facilitate activities in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be flexible, able to exercise discretion and independent judgement while interacting with colleagues across levels and around the globe.


  
* 3\+ years of supporting senior leaders, Vice President level or above preferred
* Proven expertise in administrative or operational roles, with knowledge of best practices
* Strong attention to detail, particularly as it pertains to scheduling
* Established track record of juggling multiple day\-to\-day responsibilities of an executive office concurrently, anticipating the needs of the leadership team, and prioritizing appropriately
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with leaders of all levels and the ability to handle confidential or sensitive information with both integrity and discretion
* Solid track record of staying in control of a complex workload, remaining calm under pressure, and operating with a sense of urgency when required
* High levels of proficiency with the MS Office suite \[e.g., Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint]
* Knowledge of platforms, including Teams, Ariba, Amazon Business, Concur, and Qualtrics preferred

new_jobs.description:

-----------------


SFA Partners is a financial services organization that goes beyond traditional broker\-dealer, Registered Investment Advisor, and insurance agency to provide a strategic, open, and professional, business development platform for independent advisors and their clients. Our platform enables our advisors to offer clients a comprehensive planning approach to their entire financial lives – helping clients protect, preserve, accumulate, and transfer wealth.


  
**Position Summary**



The Marketing Coordinator for SFA Partners (The Strategic Financial Alliance and Strategic Blueprint) is responsible for assisting the Director of Marketing with the day\-to\-day tactical implementation of all marketing efforts that affect and support SFA Partners internal departments as well as SFA Partners financial advisors.


**Essential Functions**



Social media and Digital media:


* Assist with sourcing and/or developing content for LinkedIn assets.
* Schedule and post content to LinkedIn.
* Monitor LinkedIn analytics continually and adjust content and frequency of posts
* Manage video library and coordinate production of additional videos as needed


Email:


* Assist with formatting bi\-weekly e\-newsletters and other ad hoc email communications to the SFA Partners Community using HubSpot.
* Collaborate with Director of Marketing and internal departments to collect information for and format department email communications to advisors.


Collateral


* Edit existing brochures and other marketing materials.
* Work with outside designers.


Websites:


* Edit websites (SFA Partners, Strategic Blueprint, and The Strategic Financial Alliance) coordinating with internal departments on changes
* Edit event calendars.
* Edit contact database.


Conferences and other events:


* Assist Conference team with marketing logistics and onsite coordination when needed.
* Assist with post\-event surveys / data collection and analysis.

* Make basic design edits to digital and print assets


* Coordinate with Human Resources to handle marketing\-related employee onboarding tasks


* Write original blog posts



**Qualifications**



Required:



* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related field of study.


* Experience with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Pilot)


* Experience with online AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude), Adobe Acrobat, Canva


* Experience in WordPress


* Experience with HubSpot or other email marketing, social media, or website platforms.


* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.



Preferred:



* Knowledge of the financial services industry (especially broker dealers and RIA, similar to Charles Schwab, Raymond James, Edward Jones, etc).


* Experience in basic graphic design.

  
**Position Summary**



The Operations Specialist is a primary contact of our operations team, serving as the primary contact for client support inquiries. This role involves managing a wide range of client requests—both written and verbal—and is responsible for problem resolution and service support for advisors and administrative staff processing client transactions through SFA Partners. The specialist will exercise decision\-making authority as delegated by the Operations Manager and Director of Operations.


**Essential Functions**


* Review and process client account information, including account openings.
* Provide general account maintenance and support.
* Review, approve, process, and follow up on incoming funds, disbursement, and asset movement requests.
* Review and process private purchase transactions within brokerage accounts.
* Manage account processing and associated fee billing on the managed account platform.
* Utilize imaging systems and workflows to maintain accurate records.
* Ensure timely completion of tasks and adherence to high service level standards.
* Generate reports to track outstanding and recurring issues, facilitating resolution and prevention.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for all operational processes and procedures, providing support to the team.
* Cross\-train with team members and mentor new employees to enhance team skills and knowledge.
* Carry out additional duties and projects as assigned by management and leadership.
* Collaborate with other departments and external vendors to cultivate strong working relationships.


**Qualifications**


* Minimum of three years of experience in the banking or financial services industry.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and broker\-dealer operations software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in customer service.
* Demonstrated sound judgment and discretion, skilled in conflict resolution.
* Exceptional organizational abilities, time management, multitasking, and priority adjustment skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills, thriving in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Team player with a collaborative mindset and positive attitude.


**Preferred:**


* Experience in securities and/or broker\-dealer environments.
* Experience with Pershing Netx360\.
* Series 7 license.

**Property Medics of Georgia**  

**Peachtree Corners, GA**  

**Full\-Time**  

**$60,000 Base Salary \+ Performance\-Based Commission \+ Bonus Opportunities**

**About the Role**


Property Medics of Georgia specializes in water, fire, and mold mitigation, contents cleaning, and reconstruction services.


We are growing our Business Development team and looking for a driven, relationship\-focused professional who can help expand our referral network and generate new business opportunities.


This is a field\-based relationship development role. Success comes from building genuine relationships with referral partners, earning trust, generating referrals, and developing those relationships into long\-term producing partnerships.


Previous experience in restoration or a related referral\-driven industry is **strongly preferred, but not required**.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify and develop high\-value referral partners throughout your territory.
* Build relationships with plumbers, insurance professionals, property managers, contractors, and other strategic referral sources.
* Prospect consistently through in\-person visits, phone calls, networking, events, and other relationship\-building activities.
* Turn new contacts into meaningful conversations, first referrals, and long\-term producing relationships.
* Maintain and grow existing referral relationships while identifying opportunities to expand relationships across organizations.
* Represent Property Medics professionally in the community and at industry events.
* Maintain accurate activity, relationship, and opportunity information in the company's CRM.
* Work closely with leadership and operations to ensure referral partners and customers receive an exceptional experience.


Requirements:  



**What We're Looking For**

* Naturally personable with strong conversational and relationship\-building skills.
* Self\-motivated, competitive, persistent, and comfortable working independently in the field.
* Comfortable walking into businesses, starting conversations, and developing relationships from scratch.
* Organized and accountable with strong follow\-up habits.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Coachable, adaptable, and willing to continuously improve.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the assigned territory.
* Previous Business Development, outside sales, account development, or relationship\-based sales experience preferred.
* **Experience in restoration, mitigation, construction, insurance, plumbing, property management, or another referral\-driven industry is strongly preferred, but not required.**
* **An existing network of relevant referral relationships is a significant plus, but not required.**

  



**Compensation**

* **$60,000 annual base salary**
* Performance\-based commission on eligible collected revenue
* Additional commission opportunities for developing new referral partners
* Bonus opportunities based on performance

**What Success Looks Like**


Success in this role isn't simply making stops or collecting business cards. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their territory, consistently creates new relationships, develops those relationships into producing referral partners, and continues to grow and strengthen their book of business over time.


Property Medics is looking for someone who enjoys being in the field, meeting people, opening doors, and turning relationships into long\-term business opportunities.

new_jobs.description:
**We Put the World on Vacation**


Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. **This is a fully virtual work from home sales position for candidates who reside in the states of Florida, Georgia and South Carolina only. Candidates who reside outside of these states will not be considered.** Successful candidates must be able to meet our work at home requirements (see below).

**How You'll Shine:**


Are you passionate about travel and skilled in sales? Join our team as a Travel Sales Representative with Travel \+ Leisure! In this role, you’ll combine your love for customer service with your sales expertise to create unforgettable travel experiences for our clients. Here’s what you’ll do:

**Sales and Customer Service:** Take inbound calls from excited customers ready to plan their dream vacations. Your expertise will guide them through the booking process for car rentals, airfare, hotel reservations, cruises and local experiences.

**Subject Matter Expertise:** As a **Travel Sales Representative,** you’ll be the go\-to resource for our customers. Build rapport and recommend personalized, lifestyle\-aligned travel solutions—air, hotel, cruise, car, and local experiences—curated for each customer.

* **$17\.50 per hour plus monthly sales incentives based off your performance**
* **Start Date: Friday October 16th**

**What You'll Bring:**

* **Proven Sales Experience:** Demonstrated success in driving results through inbound service, outbound follow\-up, and relationship\-based selling.
* **Exceptional Interpersonal Skills:** Quickly establish rapport with customers, engage in meaningful conversations, and create lasting connections. You’ll ask probing questions to understand their travel needs and seamlessly offer additional services.
* **Strong Multitasking Abilities:** Thrive under pressure and handle multiple tasks effectively.
* **Education Requirement:** High School Diploma or GED is required.
* **Customer Service and Sales Experience:** Six months of experience in both areas.
* **Travel Experience Preferred:** Six months of travel\-related experience is a plus.
* **Technology Agility:** Comfortable managing several technology applications simultaneously (CRM, booking tools, payment systems, communication apps). Prior travel software knowledge (e.g., Amadeus, Apollo, Sabre, Worldspan) is helpful but not required; ability to learn quickly is essential.
* **Training Schedule:** A 5\-week training schedule from 11:00 am to 8:00 pm EST.
* **Post\-Training Availability:** Be available to work between 8:00 am and 10:00 pm EST Monday to Saturday with a set schedule provided.
* **Holiday Availability:** Ability to work some holidays.

**What is required for me to work from home?**

* Quiet workplace free of distractions and background noise
* High speed internet requirements Download speed of 20 mbps and upload speed of 3 mbps average ping below 100m
* Must be able to hardwire computer directly to a router
* Must have own personal device with a working camera to be used for the first week of training (until our computers reach your home)
* Intermediate computer proficiency and ability to troubleshoot technical issues while at home

**So what are you waiting for? Apply today to start your next career journey with Travel \& Leisure—where you’ll deliver not just trips, but unforgettable, concierge\-level experiences for every customer!**

 **How You'll Be Rewarded:**


We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include:


***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.***

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life and accident coverage
* Disability
* Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
* 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Legal and identify theft plan
* Voluntary income protection benefits
* Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
* Employee Assistance Program

 **Where Memories Start with You**


Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

The ideal candidate is someone who can move comfortably between **creative work and detailed administrative work**.

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

The Revenue Operations Analyst will join Epsilon's Revenue Operations team in a foundational support role designed to strengthen day\-to\-day operational support for sales leaders and business partners. This role will help own operational and execution\-oriented responsibilities related to revenue operations, creating clearer focus across the team and enabling business unit partners and functional RevOps leads to stay aligned to their core areas of ownership across business partnership, process design, governance, analytics, and systems implementation.  

  

This is a strong opportunity for someone who is detail\-oriented, organized, comfortable working with data, and interested in building depth in how revenue operations supports sales execution across a complex business. The role will provide hands\-on exposure to CRM data quality, sales process and systems administration, reporting support, intake tracking, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

Sales Leader and Business Partner Support
  

* Provide operational and coordination support to sales leaders and RevOps business unit partners across recurring sales operations activities.
* Help track, organize, and follow up on sales support requests, intake items, and open operational tasks.
* Prepare and maintain recurring materials, trackers, summaries, and status updates used by sales leadership and RevOps stakeholders.

  

CRM, Data Quality, and Process Administration
  

* Assist with CRM data hygiene activities, including identifying missing, outdated, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
* Support maintenance of account, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data according to established RevOps standards.
* Help ensure sales teams are following defined processes, required fields, naming conventions, and data entry expectations.

  

Reporting and Analytics Support
  

* Support recurring sales and pipeline reporting by gathering inputs, validating data, refreshing standard reports, and preparing summaries for review.
* Assist with basic analysis of sales operations data, including pipeline movement, activity tracking, data completeness, and process adherence.
* Partner with Revenue Intelligence and business partners to clarify reporting requests and ensure needed inputs are captured accurately.
* Help document reporting definitions, field usage, and business rules to support consistency across revenue reporting.

  

Documentation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement
  

* Create and maintain documentation for repeatable sales operations processes, support workflows, and RevOps operating procedures.
* Support training and enablement efforts by helping prepare job aids, process guides, checklists, and simple how\-to materials.

  

What Success Looks Like
  

* Sales leaders and business partners receive timely, accurate support on recurring operational needs.
* Operational work is organized, tracked, and completed consistently.
* CRM and sales operations data is complete, accurate, and aligned to established standards.
* Recurring reports, trackers, and process documentation are maintained with strong attention to detail.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, marketing, or a related field.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring tasks accurately and consistently.
* Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and structured processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM and reporting tools quickly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize information clearly.
* Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment.
* Interest in revenue operations, sales operations, business process improvement, or go\-to\-market operations.

  

Preferred  

* Relevant experience through internships, coursework, project work, or prior roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, analytics, finance, or marketing operations.
* Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Experience building or maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, process documentation, or project status updates.
* Familiarity with sales pipeline, forecasting, account management, lead/opportunity workflows, or commercial operations concepts.

  

Ideal Candidate  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who is eager to learn, takes pride in accuracy, and is motivated by improving process, organization, and operational consistency. They are comfortable with operational detail, able to follow and improve repeatable processes, and interested in growing within revenue operations over time. This person should be service\-oriented, dependable, and willing to lean into the details that help sales leaders and business partners work more effectively.  

  

This role can serve as a foundation for growth into the Revenue Operations function. As the analyst builds experience, they may take on more advanced ownership of reporting, process improvement, CRM administration, project coordination, or business unit partnership support.

**When you join Epsilon, we'll create something EPIC together.** We're a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30\+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

### **Transforming Bathrooms. Changing Lives. Building Careers.**

As an In\-Home Sales Representative, you'll meet with pre\-qualified homeowners who have requested information about our remodeling services. * Conduct professional in\-home sales presentations with pre\-qualified leads
* Design customized bath remodeling solutions using our proprietary technology
* Present product options, pricing, and financing solutions
* Build rapport and establish trust with homeowners
* Close sales and deliver a best\-in\-class customer experience
* Attend ongoing training and development sessions to enhance sales performance
* Maintain accurate customer and sales records

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills
* Motivated, competitive, and goal\-oriented mindset
* Ability to confidently present and close sales
* Excellent organization and time\-management skills
* In\-home sales experience preferred
* Home improvement or remodeling sales experience is a plus
* Professional appearance and positive attitude
* Reliable transportation

----------------------------

* **100% Commission\-Based Position**
* **Unlimited Earning Potential**
* **Expected Earnings: $150,000 \- $200,000\+ per year**
* Pre\-qualified leads provided
* Comprehensive sales training and ongoing coaching
* Industry\-leading products with strong consumer demand
* Flexible schedule with high income potential
* Growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding company

**Why Join Rooftop Designs LLC?**
---------------------------------


If you're a highly motivated sales professional looking for the opportunity to earn six figures while helping homeowners improve their homes, this is the role for you. We provide the tools, training, and qualified opportunities. You bring the drive, energy, and commitment to succeed.

**Ready to take your sales career to the next level? Apply today and start earning what you're worth.**
